Title: Revenue Operations Analyst
Description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About The Role

The Revenue Operations team sits at the center of PitchBook’s go-to-market engine, translating data into the insights that power strategic decisions across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented team that takes ownership of the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data to executive dashboards, and we hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor and clarity. If you care deeply about getting the numbers right and communicating them well, you will fit right in.

The Revenue Operations Analyst, Analytics & Insights, owns performance reporting, business review cadences, and funnel and lifecycle analytics across PitchBook's go-to-market organization. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to translate data into meaningful insights that inform strategy and accelerate business growth. The ideal candidate is an intellectually curious, insights-driven analyst who enjoys asking questions, challenging assumptions, and uncovering opportunities within complex datasets. Bringing strong SQL skills, experience working with large datasets, and an enthusiasm for leveraging AI and automation to enhance analytics and decision-making.

Primary Job Responsibilities


Own weekly and monthly sales performance reporting covering pipeline, attainment, and pacing; run and maintain the WBR/MBR/QBR process end-to-end, including narrative framing and exec-ready dashboards
Build and maintain executive OKR and revenue dashboards across the full GTM funnel and post-sale lifecycle, ensuring consistent KPI definitions and reporting standards
Conduct marketing funnel analytics, campaign ROI measurement, lead routing and distribution analysis, and territory design and capacity planning analytics across global offices
Partner with Customer Success on customer lifecycle, retention, and expansion analytics; build and interpret reporting from Salesforce, Marketo, and Gong to surface clear, actionable insights
Facilitate the forecasting process across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, owning cadence, inputs, scenario reviews, and translation into the business narrative
Proactively generate insights indexed to business impact, surfacing what the business should be asking before it thinks to ask
Validate hypotheses raised by operational, field, or finance leaders, delivering rigorous analysis that confirms, challenges, or reframes the original question
Champion data quality, governance, and KPI consistency across revenue systems; identify opportunities for automation and advanced analytics in partnership with data science counterparts
Collaborate cross-functionally with RevOps, GTM Operations, Marketing Ops, and business stakeholders to align analytics work to commercial priorities
Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors
Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or Finance
3+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or finance operations
Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future


Preferred Qualifications


Solid understanding of B2B GTM and revenue metrics including pipeline health, funnel conversion, retention, expansion, and forecasting; familiarity with Salesforce reporting required, experience with Marketo or Gong is a plus
Demonstrated ability to build intuitive dashboards and compelling visualizations that help business leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident, data-driven decisions across a variety of analytics platforms
Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience querying large datasets in modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery); comfort navigating messy, high-volume data is essential
Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex data into plain language for senior stakeholders, with strong cross-functional instincts and comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and technical teams
Genuine curiosity about AI-assisted analytics and intelligent automation, and willingness to actively adopt emerging tools


Benefits + Compensation at PitchBook:

Physical Health


Comprehensive health benefits
Additional medical wellness incentives
STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance


Emotional Health


Paid sabbatical program after four years
Paid family and paternity leave
Annual educational stipend
Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement
CFA exam stipend
Robust training programs on industry and soft skills
Employee assistance program
Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days


Social Health


Matching gifts program
Employee resource groups
Subsidized emergency childcare
Dependent Care FSA
Company-wide events
Employee referral bonus program
Quarterly team building events


Financial Health


401k match
Shared ownership employee stock program
Monthly transportation stipend
Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.


Compensation


Annual base salary: $115,000-$130,000
Target annual bonus percentage: 10%

The State Filings team plays a key role with the implementation of new pricing and products within USRM by preparing, submitting, and assisting in the negotiation of proposed rating, rule, and forms changes through Department of Insurance filings and objection management.

will both work independently, and consult and collaborate with others to focus on filing strategy, objection response and avoidance, and Department of Insurance relationship management. Conducts high complexity analyses under minimal direction to answer advanced business questions, evaluate business performance, identify trends and issues, make actionable recommendations for improvements, and build advanced tools and queries for others to use.

Independently manages projects of moderate to high complexity. Presents updates, project outcomes, other high complexity analyses and results of country wide initiatives to Product managers.
Manages internal technology, vendor, and work-flow resources. Experience building with PowerBI and effective prompt engineering with Generative AI required.
Researches data at the state, competitor or countrywide level. Through research, identifies and proposes strategies to increase the speed to market of our product offerings.
Analyzes trends and is responsible for tactical and strategic recommendations.
SERFF knowledge a plus.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in business, information management, economics, or other quantitative field. Master’s degree preferred.
Minimum 4 years, typically 6 years or more of relevant work experience.
Knowledgeable in data query languages and tools; proficient in new and emerging technologies; may possess data modeling skills.
Highly developed communication and presentation skills.
In-depth knowledge of data concepts, strategies, and methodologies.
In-depth knowledge of data architectures, solutions and designs; extensive knowledge of business operations, strategies and objectives.
Highly developed negotiation, facilitation and consensus building skills.

Title: Data Analyst 3, Supply Chain Intelligence - (Hybrid - Seattle, WA)
Description:
Job Description

The Data Analyst 3 will be a senior member of the Supply Chain Intelligence (SCI) team, owning the delivery of data and insights for Nordstrom's Distribution Center and warehouse operations. The Data Analyst 3 will provide ongoing data support, performance analysis, and storytelling, which will lead to value creation and enable the next cycle of growth within Nordstrom — supporting reliable, accurate reporting and data pipeline integrity across inbound, outbound, inventory, and labor operations to help DCs run efficiently and serve customers and stores across the Nordstrom businesses.

A day in the life…


Operate as an insight partner to Distribution Center and Supply Chain leadership, not just a data provider — translating reliable, well-governed data into diagnosis, root cause, and recommended action
Own "the truth" and governance in data and process including the intake, management, automation, and integrity of data sourced from warehouse management systems and downstream data pipelines, so reporting rests on stable, validated data rather than repeated ad hoc extraction from source systems
Champion the data needs and priorities of the SCI team, coordinating with key data/business partners across the Nordstrom organization including DC Operations, Nordstrom Technology, Finance, and Supply Chain leadership
Lead and support data design requirements and delivery for SCI reporting programs and initiatives, including an ongoing legacy-to-modern BI platform migration and a broader shift toward more centralized, self-service analytics
Partner with data engineering to help ensure upstream data is accurate and well-defined, so downstream reporting can rely on consistent logic instead of every analyst re-deriving it independently
Conduct regular audits to ensure data integrity and compliance; monitor and help troubleshoot data pipeline issues, escalating and resolving in partnership with engineering
Shift time from data validation toward analysis: use a more reliable data foundation to prioritize hypothesis testing, trend diagnosis, and forward-looking recommendations over one-off data pulls
Support DC and Supply Chain business partners in the development of modernized reporting and effective analysis, creating compelling narratives and storytelling through data
Support the analysis and diagnosis of end-to-end DC and warehouse performance and provide actionable guidance to improve results
Identify and develop new measures and KPIs that support the continuous improvement and optimization of Nordstrom's supply chain
Collaborate with supply chain and operations teams to identify signals and visibility needed to enhance operations and controls; build reporting to support control monitoring
Leverage AI-assisted tools such as Claude Code and Claude Desktop to accelerate exploratory analysis and SCI reporting workflows, further shifting analyst time from manual data wrangling to insight generation


You own this if you have…


Degree in Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field required (Masters preferred)
5+ years of data management and data analysis; demonstrated ability to technically mentor and support the development of junior analysts
Demonstrated ability to move beyond descriptive reporting to diagnostic and prescriptive analysis — identifying root cause and recommending action, not just surfacing metrics
Strong understanding of ETL processes, data management principles, and data pipeline development using Apache Airflow, Dataflow
Strong understanding of normalized and de-normalized data, data warehousing, query construction, and dimensional data modeling, with applied skills in SQL and hands-on experience with BigQuery
Experience extracting and manipulating large datasets from relational databases (e.g., Oracle, PostgreSQL, or MySQL)
Proficiency in data querying and visualization/reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, IBM Cognos)
Advanced knowledge of version control tools (gitlab/github)
Experience with AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., Claude Code, Claude Desktop) to accelerate analysis, automate data workflows, and Looker development preferred
Strong operational business understanding, including potential impact of business decisions on various internal/external stakeholders and systems
Supply chain expertise in retail or consumer goods preferred, with specific focus on warehouse operations, distribution, fulfillment, receiving, or inventory management, and understanding of industry dynamics
Comfortable presenting to business stakeholders and leadership

Title: Reporting Analyst
Description:
Waverly Advisors’ primary goal is to serve our clients, one another, and our communities. We aren’t your typical wealth management firm. Our intense client focus is at the center of everything we do. We go far beyond just managing our clients’ investments, offering truly in-depth financial planning. We set ourselves apart by actually living and acting on our guiding principle, ‘Serve.’ It is the reason we go to work every day.  

In this role, you’ll be challenged to take on work that upholds our guiding principle and drives Waverly Advisors forward. We hope you’ll grow as a person and leader in your field and transform those around you as well.   

We are looking to add a Reporting Analyst to our team in our Seattle office. As a Reporting Analyst, your key focus is on preparing accurate and timely reports for institutional clients by compiling disparate data sources into a cohesive structure. This role requires a high level of precision and thoroughness. Successful candidates will exhibit a willingness to learn new skills and collaborate with team members to achieve client service standards.

Responsibilities


Coordinate the quarterly reporting cycle, including collecting, requesting, and tracking data from vendor partners and internal stakeholders.
Prepare book-wide investment performance calculations and ensure data is accurate, complete, and reconciled.
Develop and distribute quarterly participant education materials and other client-facing reporting.
Prepare, finalize, and distribute quarterly client reviews, ensuring materials are accurate and delivered on schedule.
Gather updated performance and balance information and prepare ad-hoc analyses to support client meetings, including fee reviews, plan design analyses, and participant reviews.
Document client meeting notes, action items, and deliverables and coordinate follow-throughs to ensure timely completion.
Complete post-meeting client deliverables and ongoing reporting needs while maintaining accurate and organized records.
Identify opportunities to improve, streamline, and automate recurring reporting processes and reconcile records as needed.
Support long-term, non-cyclical projects and initiatives that improve reporting, client service, and operational efficiency.
Research relevant industry trends, regulatory and legislative developments, and other applicable topics to inform client service and prepare for upcoming quarterly reporting cycles.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree, required.
A minimum of 2 years of experience in an analytical capacity. Experience in an RIA/Broker Dealer is preferred.
Familiarity with Excel, Morningstar Direct, Adobe Acrobat, PowerApps & Dataverse, preferred.
Experience with a portfolio management system. Tamarac or Orion is strongly preferred.
Excellent written and interpersonal skills.
Strong mathematical/quantitative skills.
A high level of personal initiative and willingness to assist other team members.


Travel: 


Minimal travel is required. 


Physical Requirements: 


Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. 
Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times. 
Must be able to access and navigate each department at the organization’s facilities. 


Benefits:  


Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage to support your overall well‑being. 
401(k) retirement plan with match and profit sharing to help you invest in your future. 
Twelve paid holidays each year. 
An extra vacation day during your birthday week—so you can celebrate you! 
Responsible Time Off Policy giving flexibility without annual PTO limits, while balancing team responsibilities and business needs.   
Paid sabbatical program: Enjoy four consecutive weeks of paid time off after seven years of service.  
Compensation commensurate with experience. 


Salary: $65,000-$80,000

Legal:

Title: Senior Assortment Analyst
Description:
Overview




REI Co-op works together to find better ways to work. The goal is to help people enjoy the outdoors. Working for the co-op means doing your best work. Support is given to help you live your best life. You also help shape the future of the outdoors for people and the planet.




This job contributes to REI’s success by developing location attribution, clustering and space planning solutions that support locally relevant, productive assortments across the existing retail fleet. The role uses sales, productivity, space, customer, product and location insights to inform assortment size recommendations, seasonal audits and location-based assortment strategies. Models and acts in accordance with REI’s guiding values and mission.




Responsibilities and Qualifications




Responsibilities

Develops processes, tools and location attribution inputs that support clustering, space planning and assortment decisions across the existing retail fleet, using attributes such as store location, activity, climate, customer profile, demographics, skill level and value tier.
Builds location assortment solutions that improve local relevance and productivity; incorporates customer, product, sales, space and location insights while gaining alignment with key business partners.
Defines and applies productivity measures that inform assortment size, space allocation and location-based recommendations across stores.
Translates productivity trends, category performance, regional affinity, customer insights and location attributes into recommendations that influence assortment breadth, depth and space decisions.
Supports seasonal Category Management audits by evaluating assortment size, space and location attribute opportunities and helping prioritize recommended actions.
Measures the effectiveness of location-based assortment and attribution initiatives; communicates results, insights and recommendations to improve future planning decisions.
Builds effective partnerships with cross-divisional stakeholders, including Merchandising product and planning teams, Physical Place/Visual Merchandising, Analytics, Retail and Strategy.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Merchandising or relevant field of study
3 to 5 years of merchandising, planning, analytics, or related experience involving customer and product trend analysis.
Elevated proficiency in MS Office suite including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel
Advanced proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, Excel and analytical modeling preferred; experience with clustering, location attribution, customer segmentation or space productivity analysis a plus.
Demonstrated ability to balance quantitative data and qualitative business input to make sound and effective decisions
Recognition of patterns, trends and relationships between customer needs, products and locations




Closing




At REI, we believe the outdoors is for all. We are committed to becoming a fully inclusive, anti-racist, multicultural organization. We know that there's strength in our diversity – that each employee brings unique skills, experiences, and perspectives. Every day you are driving change, fostering a culture of respect, and knowing you're backed by benefits that support your whole life. To work towards this commitment and fulfill our brand promise of inspiring and enabling a life outside for everyone, we seek employees who demonstrate different ways of working, create a sense of belonging, and actively listen and learn.




Pay Transparency

We are committed to practices that promote pay equity and transparency. As required by applicable Pay Transparency laws, REI provides a range of compensation for roles that may be hired in locations under these requirements. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include a wide array of factors, including: your specific skills and experience, geographic location or other relevant factors.




REI offers all regular employees a generous employee discount, access to health benefits, a retirement savings plan and accrued time off. Click here for a detailed overview of benefits plans by employee profile.

Title: Google Data Specialist
Description:
We Are

Accenture is a premier Google Cloud partner helping organizations modernize data ecosystems, build real-time analytics capabilities, and responsibly scale AI. As part of Accenture Cloud First and the Accenture Google Business Group (AGBG), we deliver solutions leveraging Google Cloud’s Data & AI platform—including BigQuery, Looker, Vertex AI, Gemini Foundation Models, and Gemini Enterprise.

You Are

A hands-on Specialist with foundational experience in Data Engineering, Analytics, or Machine Learning—now building deep expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You are eager to apply technical skills, learn advanced Data & AI patterns, and support delivery teams in designing and implementing modern data and AI solutions.

You’re comfortable working directly with clients, supporting senior architects, and contributing to end-to-end project execution.

The Work (What You Will Do)

As a GCP Data Specialist, you will help deliver data modernization, analytics, and AI solutions on GCP. You will support architecture design, build data pipelines and models, perform analysis, and contribute to technical implementations under guidance from senior team members.



Hands-On Technical Delivery

Build data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and integrations using GCP services such as: BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage

Assist with data modeling, performance tuning, and query optimization in BigQuery.

Implement data ingestion patterns for batch and streaming data sources.

Support development of dashboards and analytics products using Looker or Looker Studio.

Support Agentic AI & ML Solution Development

Assist in developing ML models and AI solutions using: Vertex AI, Gemini Foundation Models, Gemini Enterprise, Model APIs & Embeddings

Implement ML pipelines and help establish MLOps processes (monitoring, retraining, deployment).

Support prompt engineering, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) experimentation.

Contribute to model testing, validation, and documentation.

Requirements Gathering & Client Collaboration

Participate in client workshops to understand data needs, use cases, and technical requirements.

Help translate functional requirements into technical tasks and implementation plans.

Communicate progress, blockers, and insights to project leads and client stakeholders.

Data Governance, Quality & Security Support

Implement metadata management, data quality checks, and lineage tracking using GCP tools (Dataplex, IAM).

Follow best practices for security, identity management, and compliance.

Support operational processes for data validation, testing, and monitoring.

Continuous Learning & Team Support

Learn and apply GCP Data & AI best practices across architectural patterns, engineering standards, and AI frameworks.

Collaborate closely with senior data engineers, ML engineers, and architects.

Contribute to internal accelerators, documentation, and reusable components.

Stay current with GCP releases, Gemini model updates, and modern engineering practices.



Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's What You Need



Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Data Analytics, ML Engineering, or related fields.

Minimum of 2 years of practical experience with Google Cloud Platform.

Minimum of 2 years of experience with SQL, data modeling, and building data pipelines.

Minimum of 2 years of experience with Python or AI or GenAI tools (Vertex AI preferred).

Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If Associate’s Degree, must have equivalent minimum 6-year work experience



Bonus points if you have



Familiarity with GCP services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, Cloud Storage, and Looker.

Exposure to AI/ML development or experimentation with Vertex AI, Gemini models, embeddings, or RAG patterns.

Hands-on experience with CI/CD, Git, or cloud-native engineering practices.

Google Cloud certifications (Associate Cloud Engineer or Professional Data Engineer).

Experience working in agile delivery environments.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Description

Reporting to the Manager, Business Analytics, the Business Intelligence Analyst is responsible for transforming business data into actionable insights through data analysis, semantic model development, and other analytics solutions.

This role partners closely with our Agile Delivery team to understand requirements, communicate findings, and develop trusted analytics products that support operational and strategic decision-making.

The Business Intelligence Analyst plays a key role in building, enhancing, and maintaining enterprise data and reporting assets while partnering closely with our Agile Delivery team to understand requirements and deliver trusted analytics products that support operational and strategic decision-making.

Apply today to join our True Blue Team in Edmonton or Calgary AB today!

Essential Responsibilities:


Maintain and enhance existing Power BI models, ETL scripts (M), calculations (DAX), and design (UI/UX) in conjunction with GitHub and Jira, following best practice lifecycle development
Work with business users to assess new build requests, refine requirements using Confluence and Jira, and develop reporting content in Power BI or other reporting tools that aligns with established development best practices
Enhance the organization's catalogue of Power Apps and Power Automate solutions
Build foundational knowledge across the analytics stack, including Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Paginated Reports, Databricks, and Sigma
Support routine maintenance, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting of analytics assets and low-code solutions
Collaborate regularly with internal stakeholders, including the Construction Services Sustainment Team, business leaders, operational teams, finance teams, project teams, Information Services, Data Engineering, and Data Governance teams to gather requirements, support reporting and analytics initiatives, and drive effective business outcomes
Communicate progress, blockers, risks, and questions clearly with team members and business partners
Demonstrate curiosity, initiative, and a continuous learning mindset by asking thoughtful questions, seeking feedback, and building both technical and business knowledge
Perform other duties as assigned


Qualifications:


Minimum of a College, trade, or technical diploma or a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required
Minimum 3-5 years of experience developing business intelligence, analytics, reporting, or data visualization solutions
Experience gathering business requirements, translating them into technical solutions, and delivering reporting and analytics outcomes
Strong experience with Microsoft Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, semantic modelling, report design, and SQL
Experience working with large and complex datasets to generate actionable business insights and support decision-making
Foundational knowledge of cloud-based analytics platforms and modern data ecosystems, including Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, or similar technologies
Understanding of data management principles, including data movement, modelling, quality, governance, and security
Experience working in Agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, and sprint-based delivery methodologies
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders while managing multiple priorities
Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Teams, SharePoint, PowerPoint, and Outlook; experience supporting analytics initiatives within construction, engineering, telecommunications, infrastructure, or related industries is considered an asset


Additional Information

The Ledcor Group of Companies is one of North America’s most diversified construction companies. Ledcor is a company built on a rich history of long-standing project successes.

Our workplace culture has been recognized as one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and a Top 100 Inspiring Workplace in North America.

Our competitive total rewards package provides compensation and benefits that support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. We offer exciting, challenging work with opportunities to develop your skills and knowledge.

Employment Equity

At Ledcor we believe diversity, equity, and inclusion should be part of everything we do. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status or any other identifying characteristic are encouraged to apply.

Our True Blue team consists of individuals from all backgrounds who contribute diverse perspectives and experiences to Ledcor. We are committed to continuing to build on our culture of empowerment, inclusion and belonging.

Adjustments will be provided in all parts of our hiring process. Applicants need to make their needs known in advance by submitting a request via email. For more information about Ledcor’s Inclusion and Diversity initiatives, please visit our I&D page.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Role Summary

The McAfee Strategic Analytics team, part of the Analytics & Data Science organization, is expanding its capabilities to strengthen data-driven decision-making across a global direct-to-consumer business serving over 400 million customers. Our team is tasked with leading interesting analytics projects crossing business silos and partnering with technical experts to drive measurable outcomes.

We are looking for a Data Analyst with a product-owner mindset who will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between raw telemetry and strategic business action. You wont just pull data; you will own the narrative, building scalable solutions in Databricks and uncovering root causes that drive marketing performance and product health. You will get credit for your work and exposure to McAfee's highest levels of leadership.

This is a hybrid role based in the Waterloo, Canada. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work remotely from your home location.

Position Details

About The Role


Drive Strategic Analytics: Move beyond descriptive reporting to diagnostic and predictive analysis. You will proactively identify business variances (e.g., retention drops, funnel leakage), isolate root causes (mix shift vs. performance), and recommend actionable solutions to leadership.
Own End-to-End Execution: Act with high agency to take projects from vague problem statements to deployed solutions. You will serve as the analytics lead for your domain, managing stakeholders, defining requirements, and driving progress with minimal supervision.
Architect Scalable Solutions: Design and build robust data pipelines and sandboxes within Databricks (PySpark/SQL) that serve as the "Single Source of Truth" for the organization. You will optimize code for performance and reliability.
Communicate with Impact: Serve as a "technical translator" who can synthesize complex data findings into clear, executive-level narratives. You will present insights in high-stakes forums to drive consensus and alignment.
Foster Data Excellence: Champion best practices in data governance, definitions, documentation, and ensuring that the business trusts the numbers you produce.
We are looking for someone curious about data, passionate about building analytical solutions, and eager to become a trusted data expert who empowers others through insight and clarity.


About You


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline with 2+ years of experience.
Demonstrated proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience performing data exploration, transformation, and analysis across large-scale relational and analytical datasets.
Strong understanding of data architecture principles, including logical and physical data modeling, data structure design, and data integration best practices.
Demonstrated ability to ensure data integrity and consistency across multiple data sources, and to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable, and well-structured data solutions.
Solid background in statistical analysis and experimentation, including hypothesis testing methodologies (Frequentist, Bayesian, or multivariate A/B testing).
Familiarity with data governance practices, metadata management, and documentation standards to support transparency, consistency, and operational excellence.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to convey complex technical concepts to diverse technical and non-technical audiences.


LI-Hybrid

Company Overview

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

Company Benefits And Perks

We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.

We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.


Bonus Program
Pension and Retirement Plans
Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
Paid Time Off
Paid Parental Leave
Support for Community Involvement


We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

The anticipated compensation for this position is CAD $85,580.00/Yr. - CAD $115,780.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Citylitics Inc.

Citylitics delivers predictive intelligence on where, how, and why infrastructure investments will occur across North America.

Infrastructure includes the foundational systems that shape our quality of life: water, transportation, transit, roads and highways, broadband, and power. It represents a multi-trillion-dollar market and a 20+ year megatrend in North America.

Citylitics transforms millions of documents across more than 40,000 cities, utilities, and public agencies into real-time market signals and high-value sales intelligence. Leading infrastructure vendors, engineering firms, and construction companies use the platform to identify and pre-position for major infrastructure opportunities earlier, helping them build relationships, shape project priorities, and influence scope before projects move to formal procurement.

Citylitics combines a network of AI agents, fine-tuned models, a proprietary infrastructure signals graph, and daily human-in-the-loop quality assurance workflows to deliver highly nuanced and reliable sales intelligence. The platform integrates seamlessly with CRMs, ERPs, and data lakes, embedding actionable insights directly into sales workflows so teams can prioritize the right pursuits and build stronger pipelines.

Our mission is to improve how infrastructure investments get made so critical needs can be addressed earlier and communities benefit from stronger, more resilient infrastructure.

Join Citylitics to work in a meaningful industry that will matter for decades to come while helping grow a company at the forefront of applied AI. We operate with a Results-Driven Mentality and a commitment to Raise The Bar, in a collaborative environment where Teamwork Makes the Dream Work as we tackle big challenges and celebrate wins together.

Who Are We Looking For?

Citylitics is looking for a Data Analyst to own our Custom Solutions practice. You'll scope and deliver client-specific data requests that don't fit our standard product.

You will partner directly with Sales, Customer Success, Product and leadership to triage incoming requests, assess feasibility before anything is promised to a client, query and validate data in BigQuery, and build the one-off dashboards or reports that answer a client's actual question.

This role fits someone analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, and disciplined about scope. You size up a vague ask fast, align stakeholders when it's over-committed, and educate clients on data availability and nuances while developing solution options to discuss with them. Once you've validated an approach with the customer, you hand the engineering work to the team. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need enough confidence in SQL and data structures to know what's realistic. You're also comfortable presenting data findings and methodology directly to clients and helping them interpret what the results mean. You move quickly and decisively, without overanalyzing.

This role is based in our downtown Toronto office and requires 3+ days in-office per week.

Vacancy Status: This position is for an existing and active vacancy that Citylitics is currently seeking to fill.

What Will You Accomplish?

Triage and Scope Custom Solution Requests

You will own the front door for custom solutions requests, deciding what's worth committing to before it reaches a client.

Responsibilities include:


Field new custom-solution requests from Sales and Customer Success as they come in (Slack, demo follow-ups, live calls)
Assess feasibility and turnaround before anything is committed to a client
Align stakeholders when a request is over-scoped or under-priced
Educate clients on data availability and nuances
Develop solution options to discuss with the client before committing to delivery


Query, Validate, and Build One-Off Deliverables

You will do the actual data work behind each request, once it's been scoped.

Responsibilities include:


Query BigQuery to test and validate client-specific hypotheses
Build or update lightweight dashboards (Looker, etc) for one-off client deliverables
Disambiguate against existing coverage to avoid duplicating work


Hand Off to Engineering Once Customer Validation Is Achieved

You validate the approach with the customer before engineering builds it.

Responsibilities include:


Write up findings and requirements clients or account teams can act on directly
Hand off anything requiring pipeline or scraper-level work to engineering, with a clear spec
Surface it immediately when a client's own criteria don't hold up
Other duties as assigned


Requirements

Must-Have Experience


2+ years of experience in data analysis, solutions consulting, business analysis, or a similar role
Strong SQL fluency (BigQuery a plus), comfortable self-serve querying
Scopes an ambiguous request before diving in and defines what "done" looks like from the start
Strong written and verbal communication for client-facing summaries
Comfortable working directly with clients or internal commercial teams under a fast turnaround pace
Comfortable presenting data findings and methodology directly to clients and helping them interpret results, not just retrieving data
Moves quickly and decisively, without overanalyzing


Nice-to-Have Experience


Enough SQL/notebook fluency to spec engineering work credibly (not to build it)
Prior consulting or client-facing analyst background
Familiarity with a BI/dashboarding tool (Looker, Tableau, etc.)


Benefits

Why Citylitics?


This is a rare opportunity to influence positive change within one of the biggest societal challenges of our generation: sustainable public infrastructure
You get to support a disruptive solution with a compelling value proposition into an industry that is eager to hear from you and in a market with no direct competition
We live at the cross section of infrastructure, scaleup and data science/AI. There is no other team like us in Toronto
There is no corporate bureaucracy here. You will accomplish more here in a few months than what you would in a few years at a large, entrenched technology company
We believe that Data and AI will play an outsized role in our future, so we equip every team member with access to Generative AI tools and our full Data Universe to enhance their productivity and encourage innovation through experimentation
We are proud to offer every CityZen in-role professional growth, skill-based development & learning, and internal promotion opportunities
We work hard, we play together, we win as a team! We are on a mission to solve infrastructure while savoring the moment and celebrating the little details along the way


Citylitics is an equal opportunity employer. We are passionate about providing a safe workplace where everyone is accepted and has the opportunity to grow with us. We are committed to making diversity and inclusivity part of our culture!

Title: Database Specialist
Description:
Overview

Reporting to the Manager, Database & Integrations, the Database Specialist is responsible for the accuracy, integrity, and performance of the Foundation’s donor database. This role ensures that donor and gift information is recorded consistently, securely, and in accordance with CRA charitable receipting standards. The Database Specialist provides essential data, reporting, retrieval, interpretation, and technical support to fundraising, stewardship events, and finance teams in a fast-paced environment to advance the Foundation’s mission.

Key Duties And Responsibilities

Database administration & integrity:


Maintain and administer the Raiser’s Edge & Raiser’s Edge NXT donor database
Ensure consistent coding across records, including but not limited to campaigns, funds, appeals, attributes, package codes, solicitor assignments, and solicit codes
Perform regular data integrity & cleansing efforts including but not limited to deduplication, global changes, table maintenance, cleanup of constituent profiles, review of gift data for accuracy.


Reporting, Queries, & Analytics


Develop and manage queries, lists, dashboards and custom reports to support fundraising strategy and operations
Provide reports, data insights and analysis as needed to support the work of the development and events teams and movement through the donor journey, and to support the finance team in monthly and yearly reconciliation and audit tasks
Supply data extracts for stewardship activities, direct mail, digital campaigns, donor segmentation, and prospect identification
Experience developing and running complex queries in Raiser's Edge (RE) is considered a strong asset.


GIft Entry Oversight & Compliance


Process, review, and import gift batches from various internal and external sources into Raiser's Edge, ensuring accurate coding and prompt receipt issuance.

Title: Channel BI Data Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

We are seeking a Channel BI Data Analyst to help drive data-informed decision making across our global partner marketing organization.

This role serves as a central insights hub, responsible for building dashboards, connecting data across systems, including AI Marketing bots for partners, and uncovering insights that improve partner performance and go-to-market strategy.

This is not just a reporting role. We are looking for someone who is proactive, curious, and business minded who can analyze data, identify gaps or opportunities, and recommend actions that drive real business outcomes for our DISW partners.

Please send you CV in English.

Key Responsibilities


Data & Reporting
Build and enhance dashboards tracking KPIs such as campaign adoption, engagement, conversion, and pipeline contribution specific for our indirect channel
Refine reporting to deliver meaningful, channel-specific insights
Building/maintaining Partner Marketing Data Hub for partners
Insights & Impact
Translate data into actionable recommendations for:
Campaign Development needs
Partner Marketing follow up
Partner level recommendations
Identify high-performing industries, segments, accounts for partners
Surface gaps in campaigns or coverage and influence new campaign development or optimization
Hypothesis-Driven Thinking
Actively explore data to answer: “What is this telling us, and what should we do differently?”
Identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities from analysis that can be used by both GFM execution teams to close the gap, or information directly for the partners to continue to develop opportunities.
Develop hypotheses, validate through analysis and
Bring forward recommendation and proposals, for teams to act upon
Data Integration
Identify opportunities to connect data streams in new ways to enable better insights, activation, or campaign creation (e.g., marketing hubs, CRM, Highspot, CBA, campaign tools, and Siemens GPT)
Improve data visibility and enable more scalable, data-driven execution
Advanced Analytics
Introduce predictive insights (e.g., partner performance, campaign recommendations)
Enable automated insights like trend and anomaly detection
Focus on practical, high-impact analytics, not complex custom AI builds
Partner & Process Understanding
Engage with stakeholders and partners to understand how data is created, used, and experienced in real workflows
Use this context to improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and insight relevance
Combine data analysis with real-world understanding to explain why performance looks the way it does
Collaboration
Partner with global content, regional marketing, partner enablement, Opportunity Development and analytics teams to drive measurable impact to partner pipeline


Qualifications

Required


4+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field within or supporting B2B marketing
Strong proficiency in BI tools such as Power BI, demonstrated by the ability to architect scalable star schema data models, author advanced DAX and Power Query logic, and implement robust security and governance protocols to deliver automated, high-performance enterprise insights
Strong dashboarding and data visualization storytelling skills
Proficiency in SQL and working with large data sets
Experience building dashboards and delivering business insights
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain data to non-technical audiences, visualization of data.


Preferred


Ability to connect data insights to business outcomes and recommendations
Experience with predictive analytics or machine learning (Python, R, etc.)
Familiarity with marketing, sales, or partner/channel metrics
Experience working with tools such as CRM systems, campaign platforms, or content platforms (e.g., Highspot)
Experience integrating data across multiple systems
Experience working with generative AI tools
Mendix experience

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we Work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Job Description

Midland Transport is currently seeking a Data and Analytics Lead in Dieppe, NB. The Data and Analytics Lead is a transformation role within the Pursuit Program, accountable for serving as the primary data and analytical lead for the Maintenance domain. This role provides deep expertise in how data moves across the business—how it is created, consumed, transformed, and connected—to support integration design, operational insight development, and evidence-based decision-making throughout the transformation lifecycle.

The Data and Analytics Lead bridges the gap between business operations and data architecture by mapping current-state data flows, identifying data quality gaps, and defining future-state data requirements that align with integration strategies and platform modernization objectives. This role partners closely with Business Architects, Solution Architects, Integration Leads, Product Owners, and Operations stakeholders to ensure data integrity, analytical rigor, and alignment between domain-specific data needs and enterprise-wide data strategy—enabling confident, data-driven decisions across the transformation.

A dynamic, safe, and rewarding work environment
A flexible health, drug, dental, and vision plan
RRSP matching program
Employee & Family Assistance Programs
Health & Wellness reimbursements, includes gym memberships, fitness classes or online workout programs
3 weeks' paid vacation
Maternity leave top-up program
Growth and progression opportunities within Midland Transport and large network of the JD Irving group of companies

Act as the data and analytics lead for Maintenance, building deep understanding of data across systems and processes.
Document and align data flows with transformation goals.
Deliver insights and reporting that support decisions, process design, and business cases.
Analyze current and future data flows to identify gaps, dependencies, and improvement opportunities.
Collaborate with architects and integration leads to ensure accurate data requirements in solution design.
Define and enforce data quality standards, validation rules, and exception handling.

Advanced Data Analyst, Experimentation Lead - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking an Advanced Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will lead the Experimentation program for FC Premium Analytics. You’ll also collaborate closely with data, production, and product management partners to drive informed decision-making within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of cultivating and uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data leader, driving design, implementation, and evaluation of numerous player-facing experiments.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Design and implement player-facing experimentation using best practices in a complex, live environment
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners
Explore user behavioral patterns through experimentation to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making
Act as a subject-matter expert in all things experimentation, helping to drive adoption of a data-driven, test-and-learn focused culture across FC’s development team


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research) or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making
Expert knowledge or equivalent practical experience in leading an experimentation function for a live product
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a strong plus.

Description:
Business Intelligence Analyst

Contract Length: 1 year

Location: Vancouver, British Columbia

Work Schedule arrangement: Hybrid




Raise is currently hiring a Business Intelligence Abalyst on behalf of our client. They’re expanding their team to meet growing needs, making this a unique opportunity to work with an industry leader. Our client, a partnership of 12 municipalities - one Electoral Area and one treaty First Nation. That collaboratively plans for and delivers regional-scale services with its core services being drinking water, wastewater treatment and solid waste management.

Note: The primary pay rate is based on T4 classification; however, we will also consider applications from candidates interested in an INC classification, where applicable.




The Business Intelligence Analyst will work in collaboration with our Business Strategy and Improvement Team and will focus on:

• Translating business requirements into technical specifications

• Data profiling

• Source data analysis with SQL or applicable tools

• Business Analysis

• Designing and developing the data analytics (data warehouse, data lake ODS, data modelling, Power BI security, Power BI workspace) reusable framework

• Designing data models based on technical specifications

• Exploring advanced Power BI features for analytics, including customized solutions such as Dataflows and Datamarts

• Designing and building data pipelines and ETL packages including: o M Query

o Dax Language

o Power Query

o Dashboards and reports with Power BI Desktop

o Troubleshoot day-to-day data warehouse issues

The position requires the following technical qualifications:

• Design, build, and deploy BI solutions (e.g., reporting tools, dashboards)

• Maintain and improve existing BI systems

• Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle).

• Experience with on-premise data warehouse reusable framework design and implementation

• Experience with data modelling, analysis, and visualization

• Work with relational and non-relational databases to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data

• Experience with building data pipelines and ETL processes

• Extensive development experience with technologies including SQL Server, REST APIs, OLAP cubes, and BI analytics tools.

• Extensive analytic development experience with Power BI and preferably Microsoft Power Platform.

• Advanced Power BI Service configuration experience, including Power BI Dataflows and Datamarts.

• Experience in Power BI report development, reports automation with data source refresh configurations

• Experience with analyzing data source systems to identify data transformation needs

• Thorough knowledge of software development methods, practices and procedures

• Ability to prepare technical design and write technical specifications

• Experience using Azure DevOps to manage projects is preferred

• Experience with programming languages such as Python or R is a plus

• Experience with Microsoft Fabric for data integration, data warehousing, analytics, semantic modeling, and enterprise reporting solutions is considered a strong asset

In addition, this position requires the ability to:

• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with a variety of internal contacts

• Provide advice and assistance on matters related to the work

• Ability to document, analyze, and assess a variety of information; identify priorities and resources; and propose alternative business processes.

• Demonstrated experience reviewing, streamlining and standardizing technical and operational documentation.

• Ability to develop practical standards that promote consistency while remaining easy for teams to maintain.

• Ability to assist in the development of standards and perform other administrative tasks related to assigned work

• Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing and to present proposals in non-technical language

• Perform assigned duties with minimal supervision, although direction will be given.

• Maintain confidentiality

Description:
Enercare Inc. is one of Canada’s largest home and commercial services companies servicing over one million customers across Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Alberta, British Columbia, Quebec and New Brunswick. Enercare is the Experts at Home, operating under several brands including Enercare, HydroSolution, and Pioneer Plumbing & Heating.

Role: Workforce Management Analyst

Status: Full-Time

Reporting To: Manager - Workforce Management

Location: Niagara/Markham

Compensation: $59,564 - $95,302




Please note that the compensation range listed includes base salary and potential incentive pay. Incentives such as bonuses are not guaranteed and depend on individual performance and company results. Actual compensation within the range will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications.




Job Summary

We are seeking an analytical and forward-thinking Workforce Analyst to support workforce planning for a Home Services contact center. This role is responsible for developing accurate call volume forecasts, staffing models, and capacity plans that enable the organization to achieve customer experience, service level, and cost objectives.




The primary focus of this role is leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI), predictive analytics, and advanced Microsoft Excel modeling to improve forecasting accuracy and uncover actionable business insights. The successful candidate will use AI-powered tools and forecasting technologies to identify trends, detect anomalies, model demand drivers, evaluate scenarios, and generate data-driven staffing recommendations. While workforce management experience is important, we are specifically seeking candidates who embrace AI as a strategic forecasting tool and understand how to combine AI-generated insights with operational expertise and human judgment.




This position is ideal for an intermediate-to-senior workforce professional who has experience using AI solutions, advanced analytics, and Excel-based forecasting techniques to solve complex workforce planning challenges in a high-volume contact center environment.




Key Responsibilities




AI-Driven Forecasting & Predictive Analytics

Utilize AI-powered forecasting tools and predictive analytics platforms to improve call volume forecasting accuracy.
Leverage machine learning and AI-generated insights to identify emerging trends, seasonality patterns, demand drivers, and operational risks.
Evaluate AI-generated forecasts and apply business knowledge to validate assumptions and refine outputs.
Use AI tools to automate data analysis, trend identification, anomaly detection, and forecast variance investigations.
Integrate traditional forecasting methodologies with AI-driven recommendations to create accurate and actionable demand plans.
Continuously assess new AI technologies and forecasting capabilities that can improve workforce planning effectiveness.




Forecasting & Capacity Planning

Develop monthly, weekly, daily, and interval-level forecasts for inbound contact center demand.
Analyze historical call volumes, AHT, service levels, customer behavior, marketing activity, weather impacts, and operational changes to support forecasting decisions.
Translate forecasted workload into staffing requirements, productive hours, schedules, and FTE recommendations.
Create multiple forecast scenarios to assess business impacts and staffing risks.
Monitor forecast accuracy and identify opportunities to improve forecasting models and assumptions.




Business Intelligence & Data Analysis

Combine AI-generated insights with advanced Excel analysis to deliver workforce recommendations.
Build dashboards, forecasting models, and reporting tools that support data-driven decision-making.
Utilize large datasets to uncover trends, root causes, and performance improvement opportunities.
Present findings and recommendations to Operations, Workforce Management, and senior leadership.




Required Qualifications

4–7+ years of Workforce Management, Forecasting, Capacity Planning, Workforce Analytics, or Contact Center Operations experience.
Demonstrated experience using Artificial Intelligence, predictive analytics tools, machine learning platforms, or AI-assisted forecasting solutions to support business planning and forecasting decisions.
Advanced Microsoft Excel expertise, including forecasting models, Power Query, Pivot Tables, statistical analysis, scenario modeling, and data visualization.
Experience translating demand forecasts into staffing plans and workforce recommendations.
Strong understanding of contact center metrics including call volume, AHT, service level, ASA, occupancy, shrinkage, and forecast accuracy.
Proven ability to evaluate AI-generated recommendations and apply business judgment to improve forecast outcomes.




Preferred Qualifications

Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, or similar platforms) to support forecasting analysis, reporting, trend identification, and productivity improvements.
Advanced Microsoft Excel capability, including the ability to build and maintain complex forecasting and staffing models.
Experience working with predictive analytics, machine learning models, or advanced forecasting software.
Knowledge of Power BI, SQL, Python, R, or other analytical tools used in workforce planning environments.
Experience implementing AI-driven process improvements or automation initiatives within Workforce Management functions.




Core Technical Competencies




AI-Assisted Forecasting & Predictive Analytics

Machine learning forecasting concepts
Predictive modeling
AI-driven trend analysis
Pattern recognition
Forecast optimization
Anomaly detection
Scenario modeling
Data interpretation and validation




Advanced Microsoft Excel Forecasting

Statistical forecasting models
Trend and seasonality analysis
Forecast accuracy measurement
Driver-based forecasting
Workforce capacity calculations
Power Query and data transformation
Advanced formulas and automation




Workforce Planning & Contact Center Analytics

Staffing requirement calculations
Capacity planning
Erlang concepts
Shrinkage modeling
Service level forecasting
Intraday planning
Forecast performance analysis

Title: Evaluation and Measurement Analyst
Description:
Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

The Training Evaluation & Measurement Analyst is responsible for assessing the effectiveness and impact of learning programs by supporting the design of measurement strategies, analyzing training data, and providing actionable insights to improve learning outcomes and business performance. This role works closely with course owners, SMEs, and stakeholders to ensure training delivers measurable value.

Data Collection & Analysis


Collect and validate data from multiple sources (e.g., LMS, surveys, assessments)
Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities
Perform statistical analysis (e.g., pass rates, item difficulty, distractor analysis) to assess assessment quality


Reporting & Insights


Review dashboards and reports to communicate training performance and outcomes
Translate data into clear, actionable insights for course owners and stakeholders
Provide recommendations for course improvements based on findings


Continuous Improvement


Monitor training effectiveness throughout the lifecycle (pre-, during, and post-delivery)
Partner with SMEs and course owners to refine content, assessments, and delivery methods
Support post-course evaluations and follow-up analysis (e.g., behavior and performance impact)


What You Will Do

As a Training Evaluation & Measurement Analyst, you will play a key role in helping KPMG Business School understand and improve the effectiveness of its learning programs. Working closely with course owners, subject matter experts (SMEs), and other stakeholders, you will transform learning data into meaningful insights that drive better learning experiences and business outcomes.

In this role, you will


Collect, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources, including learning management systems, surveys and assessments.
Identify trends, patterns, learning gaps, and opportunities for improvement through quantitative and qualitative analysis.
Conduct measurement and evaluation activities, including assessment analysis, learner feedback reviews, pass rate analysis, item difficulty reviews, and other evaluation methodologies.

Job Title: Senior Program and Risk Analyst

Location: Winnipeg, MB, Canada, and Summerside, PEI, Canada

Build an Aviation Career You’re Proud Of

At StandardAero, we use our ingenuity and know-how to find solutions for the simple to the most complex challenges in aviation. Together, we get the job done and done well. Our stability, resources, and respectful culture supports you in building a solid career with a great team you can count on day in and day out for the long term.

As a Senior Program and Risk Analyst, you’ll conduct analysis based on the customer’s current maintenance schedule & flying patterns for all proposed bids. The analyst is relied upon to provide accurate data and insight to the Commercial Solutions team to ensure that bids for new and existing programs meet both StandardAero and customer requirements.

What You’ll Do


Designs, creates, and implements event forecasting data collection processes, program analysis models, and market forecasting tools for commercial fleet programs throughout the Sector.
Provides consultation and ongoing support / mentorship to Program Management and Commercial Solutions personnel in the Sector in data collection, program analysis and risk management methodologies and techniques for the purpose of program financial reconciliations and managing overall program health.
Gathers and reviews event cost and work scope data from a variety of sources and periodically assists business units in developing baseline cost models for bid and strategic planning purposes, and measuring actual work scope cost against baseline.
Responsible for ensuring program financial models are as accurate as possible and meet established criteria for business plans


Basic Qualifications


University or college degree in engineering, technologist, finance, or data science with a focus on cost analysis
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel required, including experience with PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, charts, data analysis tools, and large data sets
Experience performing data analysis, cost analysis, forecasting, or quantitative analysis using statistical methods required


Desired Skills


Previous experience in the aerospace field or engine MRO environment
Strong knowledge of Visual Basic or Visual Basic for Applications preferred
Strong team player who thrives in an ever-challenging environment
Strong planning, organizational, analytical, leadership, decision making, interpersonal, oral and written communication skills

Comprehensive Healthcare
401(k) with 100% company match; up to 5% vested
Paid Time Off starting on day one
Bonus opportunities
Health- & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
Short- & Long-Term Disability
Life & AD&D Insurance
Learning & Training opportunities
