Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Hi, we're HUB!

We are a leading North American insurance brokerage that advises businesses and individuals on how to reach their goals. When you partner with us, you're at the center of a vast network of risk, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management specialists that bring clarity to a changing world with tailored solutions and unrelenting advocacy – so you're ready for tomorrow.

The Opportunity!

This is a permanent, full-time position, reporting to the Director, Business Intelligence at HUB Canada West (HCW).

As the Data Scientist, you are the technical engine of a small, high-leverage analytics function. This role exists to turn HCW's growing data foundation across cloud data platforms and SQL into measurable business value: predictive models, self-serve analytics, intelligent automation, and AI-powered tools that change how branches and leadership make decisions.

The successful candidate brings classical data science fundamentals (statistics, machine learning, experimental design) and is equally comfortable in the emerging world of AI engineering: prompting and orchestrating large language models, building reusable AI workflows, and integrating LLMs into BI products. As the discipline of data science continues to converge with AI engineering, we want someone who can move fluidly across both.

You will operate as a senior individual contributor and a generalist problem solver. You enjoy ambiguity, you pick up new tools quickly, and you care about outcomes more than orthodoxy.

What You'll Bring To Our Team -


5+ years of hands-on experience in data science, analytics engineering, advanced analytics, or a directly related applied technical role.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or similar). Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered in lieu of formal credentials.
Background in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry is a strong asset, with practical familiarity with concepts such as policies in force, premium, retention, and producer compensation.
A generalist, problem-solving mindset: comfortable picking up new tools, languages, and platforms; energized by ambiguity rather than blocked by it.


Skills & Competencies

Must-Haves


Strong SQL skills, including comfort with complex joins, and query optimization against large datasets.
Strong Python skills for analysis, modelling, and automation (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy), plus practical experience with ML Algorithms such as Random Forest, Recommender Systems or Clustering.
Demonstrated production experience with Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, and the ability to design dashboards that leadership can intuitively use.
Working knowledge of statistics, machine learning fundamentals, and model evaluation; able to choose the right tool for the question rather than reaching for the most complex one.
Demonstrated ability to use Claude (or other AI tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, or equivalent) as a serious working tool: structured prompting, iterative refinement, awareness of failure modes, guardrails, and the discipline to verify outputs.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical findings into business decisions and to write clearly for executive audiences.


Nice-to-Haves


Experience building Claude Skills, artifacts, MCP server integrations, or agentic AI workflows.
General familiarity with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery, is a plus as HCW's data environment evolves.
Experience with light data engineering tooling such as dbt, Airflow, or Cloud Composer.
Comfort with version control (Git), code review practices, and collaborative development workflows.
Familiarity with Canadian data privacy requirements (PIPEDA) and the practical realities of working with sensitive customer and HR data.


A Day in the Life -

Analytics And Modelling


Design and deliver applied analytics and machine learning solutions across sales, retention, finance, operations, and talent (for example, customer segmentation, churn and renewal probability, book of business analytics, producer performance modelling).
Translate ambiguous business questions from leadership into structured analytical problems, choose the right level of methodological rigour for the decision at hand, and communicate results in plain language.
Apply solid statistical thinking to model evaluation, uncertainty quantification, and the honest framing of data quality limitations.


AI Engineering


Build and maintain production-grade prompts, Claude Skills, and AI-assisted workflows that extend HCW's analytical reach (for example, manager-facing prompt playbooks for self-serve call analytics).
Integrate large language models with HCW data sources to enable natural-language analytics, automated narrative generation, and intelligent document processing.
Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape and bring promising techniques into HCW thoughtfully, with appropriate guardrails.


Data Access And Transformation


Extract, join, and transform data from HCW's data warehouse, Power BI semantic layer, and other source systems to support analytical work. Note: this is not a heavy data engineering role. Platform, ingestion, and core pipeline work sits primarily with the Canada Data team and Corporate IT. The Data Scientist is expected to access and shape data, not to build the warehouse.
Engineer features, build reproducible analytical pipelines, and document data lineage and assumptions.


Business Intelligence And Self-Serve


Build interactive Power BI dashboards that make analytical output usable by branch managers, regional leadership, and corporate executives.
Develop reusable Power BI templates and data structures that let branch managers, regional leadership, and corporate executives self-serve their own analysis without relying on ad hoc analyst support.
Track adoption of Power BI reports and dashboards, and surface how they are being used to drive measurable business value across branches and leadership.


Automation


Identify high-friction manual reporting and operational workflows, then automate them using Python, scheduled data pipeline jobs, Power Automate, or AI-powered workflows.
Design automation that is observable, recoverable, and trusted by the business.


Stakeholder Engagement And Communication


Work directly with the COO, regional leadership, and operational managers to scope work and present findings.
Coach and uplift the broader BI community of practice on Python, SQL, AI tooling, and analytical thinking.
Collaborate with the Canada Data team and Corporate IT on data standards, governance, and shared platform decisions.


Salary Expectations -

The expected salary range for this position is $90,000.00 to $115,000.00 and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate's skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position's business line, scope, and level. HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include extended health benefits, disability insurance, RRSP matching, paid-time-off benefits, and eligible bonuses. If you believe that your qualifications and experience surpass the minimum requirements for this role, we encourage you to submit your application. By doing so, we will be able to keep your application on file for consideration for potential future positions within our organization.

Why Join HUB?


Do you enjoy making friends? We love making friends; join our team of amazing people who all get along and thrive together!
We work hard and play hard! Get ready for our Staff Holiday Parties!!
Paid day off for your birthday – we want to celebrate you!
Paid day off for volunteering in your community – HUB is a company that gives back and is active in our communities.
Room to grow within the organization.
Lots of company perks, benefits, RRSP matching and great compensation.


Your Future with HUB -

Choose a career with HUB International and take the first step toward creating a future that combines a diverse, challenging work environment with financial security and career satisfaction. By joining HUB, you will become part of a rapidly growing company that offers significant opportunity for advancement.

At HUB, we value education and continuous learning, and we will assist you along your career development path. We provide HUB Ready training for new employees, as well as financial support for licensing, industry designations, management & leadership development, and other related courses, designations or programs.

What makes us different than all the rest?

Our Vision: To be everywhere risk exists – today and tomorrow. Helping protect what matters most.

Our Mission: To protect and support the aspirations of individuals, families and businesses. To empower our employees to learn, grow and make a difference in their communities.

Our Core Values


Entrepreneurship: We encourage innovation and educated risk-taking.
Integrity: We do the right thing every time.
Teamwork: We work together to maximize results.
Accountability: We measure and take responsibility for outcomes.
Service: We serve customers, communities and colleagues.


If you value what we value, and like the perks along the way – Apply TODAY!

The employment offer is contingent upon completion of a successful background check.

HUB is a company where your contributions will make a difference. We invite you to learn more about our team at www.hubinternational.com. If you require any accommodations during the hiring process, please reach out to hcw.hr@hubinternational.com to request this. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Department Business Operations

Required Experience: 5-7 years of relevant experience

Required Travel: No Travel Required

We endeavor to make this website accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact the recruiting team HUBRecruiting@hubinternational.com. This contact information is for accommodation requests only; do not use this contact information to inquire about the status of applications.

Position Overview

Are you passionate about transforming complex operational data into meaningful insights? As an Operations Reporting Analyst, you'll play a key role in helping leaders make informed business decisions by analyzing operational performance, identifying trends, and developing reporting solutions that drive continuous improvement.

In this role, you'll partner with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful reporting, benchmarking, and analytical insights that support operational excellence and strategic planning.

In this role, you will


Analyze operational metrics, activities, and costs to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement.
Develop, maintain, and enhance ERP-based reports and queries that support business operations and decision-making.
Conduct benchmarking, cost, and performance analyses to help establish targets and evaluate operational results.
Perform trend analysis, forecasting, and scenario modeling to assess potential business impacts and support strategic planning.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, investigate data gaps, and deliver actionable insights.
Present findings and recommendations that improve reporting practices, processes, and operational performance.
Support continuous improvement initiatives, system enhancements, and implementation projects.
Create training materials and procedural documentation that help users effectively understand and utilize reporting tools.


Requirements


Education: Successful completion of Diploma in Accounting, Finance, or a related field from an accredited post-secondary institution.
Experience: Minimum of six (6) years’ experience of recent and related experience, of which one year experience involves complex data analytics.
Strong analytical skills including the ability to organize, interpret and present data through reports, summaries and procedural documentation.
Excellent organizational skills, initiative and ability to balance priorities and meet deadlines.
Working knowledge of statistical analysis, cost-benefit analysis and related analytical techniques.
Advanced knowledge of ERP financial systems (e.g. SAP) and reporting tools (including SAP BW) used to support cost accounting as well as other specialized software used within the department.

Strong interpersonal, presentation, verbal and written communication skills.

TBWA

Are you an avid data analyst looking for an exciting career in the world of media? Are you obsessed with ROI? Do you like optimizing stuff? We at TBWA look to uncover key business insights and solve complex problems with the power of data.

Work closely with business stakeholders to understand business requirements; find and analyze appropriate data sources and provide data-driven solutions to key business problems

Contribute to audience and ad campaign planning and measurement solutions on a proprietary data platform

Work closely with media, strategy and creative teams in an agency setup to provide overall data analytics support for planning and executing media campaigns

Develop and maintain strategic business performance Tableau dashboards

Analyze competitive landscape and provide regular share of voice and share of market analyses and projections

Curiosity and attention to detail

2–3 years of experience in data analytics or data science, ideally in a media or marketing environment

Fluency in SQL and Python & MS Excel

Fluency with data, analytics, and visualization technologies (we use SQL, Python, Tableau)

Nice to haves

Experience in media agency or marketing is a strong plus

Knowledge of media mix modeling, multi-touch attribution and other forms of ROI modeling

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You And The Role

Zipline is on a mission to transform how goods move by making autonomous drone delivery the fastest, most reliable, and most delightful logistics system in the world. As we continue to scale our Platform 2 (P2) business, we are looking for a Business Data Analyst to help turn data into actionable insights that drive growth.

As a member of Zipline's centralized Data Science & Analytics team, you will serve as an embedded business and analytics partner to stakeholders across Marketing, Commercial, and Growth. You will help teams make better decisions by translating business questions into analyses, dashboards, and recommendations that improve performance, identify opportunities, and accelerate growth.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining technical expertise with business curiosity. You are comfortable working with large datasets, building intuitive reporting solutions, and communicating complex findings in ways that inspire action. You are excited by the opportunity to use modern analytics and AI tools to automate manual work, improve visibility, and help Zipline scale efficiently.

What You'll Do


Own analyses of customer behavior, commercial performance, market dynamics, and Platform 2 growth opportunities.
Define KPI frameworks and metric definitions that give Marketing, Commercial, and Growth teams a consistent view of progress against strategic priorities.
Build and maintain business-facing dashboards and self-service reporting that stakeholders use to assess performance and plan action.
Translate analysis into recommendations that inform campaign investment, commercial prioritization, growth initiatives, and strategic tradeoffs.
Monitor performance to identify material trends, risks, and opportunities requiring a decision or change in business approach.
Partner with Data Science, Product, and business teams to improve data quality, reporting capabilities, and analytical processes.
Use AI-enabled workflows to automate recurring reporting and analysis, reducing manual work and improving the speed of insight delivery.



What You'll Bring


5+ years of experience delivering analytics or business intelligence work in analytics, operations, technology, logistics, eCommerce, or a related environment.
Advanced SQL proficiency and experience querying complex relational datasets.
Experience building business-facing dashboards in Sigma, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or a similar platform.
Familiarity with data warehouses such as Snowflake or Redshift and a scripting language such as Python.
Ability to turn ambiguous commercial or growth questions into rigorous analyses, clear measurement approaches, and actionable recommendations.
Strong communication and business judgment, with evidence of helping technical and non-technical stakeholders act on data.
Experience using AI tools to automate analytical workflows or recurring reporting, plus a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or related field.



What Else You Need To Know

The starting cash range for this role is $140,000 - $180,000. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; overtime pay; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more.

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship, or other characteristics protected by state, federal or local law or our other policies.

We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply!

Description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.

Great decisions aren't built on intuition alone – they're built on data.

As a Staff Data Analyst, you'll partner with teams across the organization to transform data into meaningful insights that drive smarter decisions. You'll help leaders understand business performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and measure the impact of strategic initiatives.

The best analysts don't just report what happened – they help teams understand why it happened and what to do next. That's the kind of impact we're looking for in this role.

Some of the Problems You'll Solve:

🧪 Which initiatives create the greatest impact?

Design and analyze experiments, pilots, and performance evaluations that separate signal from noise and support confident decision-making.

📈 How healthy is the business?

Build dashboards and reporting that provide leaders with visibility into operational performance, customer outcomes, and organizational health.

🔍 What trends should we be paying attention to?

Analyze data across multiple sources to identify patterns, emerging opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

👥 What behaviors drive successful outcomes?

Use segmentation, cohort analysis, and behavioral data to understand customers, users, or operational processes and identify opportunities to improve results.

🤝 How can data guide better decisions?

Partner with stakeholders across departments to answer high-impact business questions, evaluate tradeoffs, and provide analytical recommendations.

🎯 What should we be measuring that we aren't today?

Improve data quality, instrumentation, and reporting by identifying gaps in existing data collection and helping teams capture the information needed to make informed decisions.

How You'll Make an Impact:

📊 Build confidence in business decisions by designing analyses and communicating insights that help teams understand what is working – and what isn't.

📈 Turn data into strategic direction by uncovering trends, identifying opportunities, and providing actionable recommendations.

📉 Create visibility into organizational performance through dashboards, reporting, and metrics that stakeholders rely on every day.

🤝 Partner with cross-functional teams to frame business problems, evaluate options, and ensure decisions are supported by data.

🎯 Develop meaningful metrics and reporting frameworks that enable teams to consistently measure success and track progress over time.

🔍 Identify opportunities to improve business processes, customer experiences, and operational efficiency through thoughtful analysis.

🧩 Bring clarity to complex problems by asking the right questions, exploring the data, and delivering insights that move the business forward.

You'll Probably Thrive Here If You:

🧩 Use data to drive decisions.

You have a track record of solving complex business problems through thoughtful analysis and influencing decisions with data.

📊 Have strong analytical fundamentals.

SQL is a core part of your toolkit, and you're comfortable working with large datasets to uncover meaningful insights.

📈 Think beyond reporting.

You don't just build dashboards – you investigate root causes, identify opportunities, and recommend actions.

💬 Communicate with clarity.

You can explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences and help stakeholders make informed decisions.

🤝 Enjoy solving ambiguous problems.

You're comfortable starting with a business question—not a predefined report—and determining what data, analyses, or metrics are needed to answer it.

🔄 Adapt quickly to new tools and technologies.

You enjoy learning new platforms and approaches and focus on solving problems rather than relying on a specific technology stack.

🛠 Bring experience with modern analytics tools.

Experience with SQL, Python, R, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar analytics platforms is a plus, but not required. Great analysts learn new tools. Great critical thinking is harder to teach.

Benefits:

🤑 Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages for all employees

🏥 Healthcare Plan: Platinum medical, dental, and vision

🛡️ Free life insurance: Including long-term disability & short-term disability

🏄 Unlimited PTO: Uncapped vacation days & paid holidays

👶 Family Leave: Maternity & paternity

📈 401(k) Contribution: Assured contributes 3% of your income, even if you don't contribute

🏠 WFH Benefits: Lunch on us 2x/week, monthly phone stipend & other home office perks

👪 Health FSAs & HSAs: Pre-tax accounts for out-of-pocket medical expenses

🤝 Team events & Offsites: We're remote, but we regularly get together

Title: Data Analyst II - Omni Analytics
Description:
Tailored Brands, Inc. is a leading omni-channel specialty retailer of menswear, including suits and a broad selection of business casual offerings as well as the largest provider of tuxedo rental products in the U.S. and Canada. We operate retail stores in all 50 states and Canada. Our U.S. retail stores are operated under the brand names of Men’s Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Men’s Wearhouse and Tux, and K&G Fashion. Our Canadian stores are operated under the brand name of Moores in ten provinces. Our purpose is we help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments. We accomplish this by putting customers at the center of every decision, rallying together to achieve common goals, and striving for excellence and continuous improvement. We help fulfill this purpose by valuing differences and knowing they make us better and showing up with courage to always do the right thing. If you want to make a difference, be part of a great team and grow, you might be a perfect fit.

About The Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for an Data Analyst II – Omni Analytics to join the Tailored Brands Enterprise Analytics team. You will serve as a vital role as a “data detective” investigating trends underlying KPIs to uncover the "why" behind performance. Collaborating with merchandising and ecomm teams, you will go beyond retrospective reporting to identify who is impacted and what it means for our future. Your proactive, forward-looking insights will guide, monitor, and measure key ecomm and merchandising strategies.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities


Data Analysis: Dive deep into sales, inventory, and website activity to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.
Reporting: Create clear, concise, and insightful dashboards via Power Bi, Looker Studio, and Excel Pivots.
Forecasting: Use statistical models to create forward-looking prediction models.
Presentations: Present analyses in a clear, interpretable, and applicable way that can be shared widely, communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.
Collaborate: Partner with data engineering, ecommerce teams, and across analytics to share learnings, align on methodologies and leverage best practices.


What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, business, merchandising, or a related field is required.
Minimum of 3 years career experience in a similar role
SQL: Proficiency in querying databases for data extraction is required.
Data Visualization: Experience visualizing insights in enterprise Business Intelligence tools effectively is required, preferably in Power BI.
AI Tools: Ability to use tools (such as CoPilot and Glean) to amplify, but not replace thinking, in work is required.
Google Analytics: Proficiency in analyzing data in GA is preferred.
Python/R: Proficiency in scripting data manipulation and modeling for analysis is preferred.


Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands


Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time.
Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment.
Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, from a remote office location.


Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go to mytbtotalrewards.com.

Work-Life Balance

Responsibilities

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:


Meeting-Free Fridays (encouraged) | so you can catch up on work and self-development.
Summer Fridays | from Memorial Day to Labor Day so you can enjoy a head-start to the weekend.
Holiday Early Departure | close out early the business day before a company observed holiday.


The starting salary for this position is $92,810 – $142,350. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, and qualifications. Over time, and subject to performance, tenure, and evolving responsibilities, total compensation for this role may grow to as much as $193,294. Base pay information is based on market location and may be subject to prevailing wage laws, if applicable.

Note: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities or qualifications associated with this job.

Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.

Job Summary

Supermicro is seeking a Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will work closely with Sales, Operations, Product Management, and Procurement teams to coordinate forecast meetings, foster cross-team alignment, and support planning initiatives.

Strong communication skills, multitasking ability, and deadline management are essential. You will generate reports, analyze trends, and interpret data using tools such as Excel, SQL, and BI dashboards, ensuring data accuracy and thorough validation.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities


Prepare and deliver monthly reports to support forecasting and business review processes.
Assist in developing and enhancing data management systems to improve forecasting capabilities.
Maintain and update forecasts on a daily and weekly basis to reflect the latest trends and insights.
Work closely with cross-functional teams—including Sales, Project Management, Product Management, and Procurement—to facilitate and support Sales Forecast meetings, ensuring alignment and effective collaboration.
Support system enhancements and changes related to operations and data workflows.
Provide strategic and analytical support to management for organizational planning and decision-making.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by applying best practices in data collection, validation, and analysis.
Monitor internal client and team feedback to identify and recommend process improvements.
Champion and uphold the company’s mission, vision, and core values in daily activities.
Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.


Qualifications


SQL Server proficiency and Data modeling — including complex queries, joins, CTEs, window functions, stored procedures, performance tuning, database design, normalization, and schema interpretation.
Microsoft 365 analytics tools: Excel, Power BI and SharePoint/OneDrive.
Data quality and validation — ability to identify anomalies, inconsistencies, and integrity issues.
Basic scripting — Python or R for data manipulation or automation.
Windows environment fluency — file systems, permissions, scheduled tasks, and general troubleshooting.
Analytical & Business Skills — Skilled in translating business questions into measurable insights through KPI development, dashboard reporting, data analysis, and adherence to data governance, security, and compliance best practices.


Required Experience


2–5 years of experience in a data analyst, business intelligence, or reporting role.
Hands‑on experience working with Microsoft SQL Server in production environments.
Experience building and maintaining Power BI dashboards or similar BI tools.
Demonstrated history of supporting business teams (finance, operations, sales, HR, etc.) with data insights.
Experience working with large datasets, data cleansing, and data validation.
Prior work in environments using Microsoft 365 for collaboration and reporting.


Preferred / Nice‑to‑Have


Experience with SSRS (SQL Server Reporting Services).
Familiarity with version control (Git) for SQL scripts or analytics code.
Experience with statistical analysis or forecasting.


Salary Range

$90,000 - $110,000

The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Corporate Overview



Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster. They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.

We believe in:

The direct measurability of digital media.
Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

 

Job Category

In this role you will become an expert on optimal performance and strategy of digital marketing campaigns. You will work with fellow analysts to analyze, conjecture, and manage investigations, product fixes, and optimizations to increase our yield and support our relationships with Media Partners.

You will be required to develop a deep understanding of the related data sources and leverage them to inform business decisions. You will be required to develop a deep understanding of our analytical tools and the automation of business processes and decision-making. Title: Data Analyst, Semi Service Programs
Description:
What To Expect
Tesla is seeking a Data Analyst to serve as the data and reporting champion to serve the needs of the Semi program. You will create and translate data into useful, easily digestible information that can quickly be translated into action via recommendations you will make. These reports and visuals will be used by many teams and leaders internally to get maximum utilization of the Semi, increase team efficiency, drive new sustainable revenue, and provide insights to our customers, both internally and externally.

What You'll Do


Design and deliver clear reports, service center KPIs and visualizations to inform stakeholders and ensure clarity and alignment on strategic goals of Semi Service Programs
Develop and maintain data pipelines for cleaning, extracting, and aggregating datasets to support reporting, predictive analysis, and decision-making across Semi Service initiatives
Write clean, tested code that can be maintained and extended upon by other analysts. Provide information and insights to the service programs team and collaborate cross-functionally in the creation of customer-facing materials
Act as a liaison between technical and non-technical teams, translating complex data findings into actionable recommendations for managers and executives
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., Business Development, Field Service, Service Quality, and Program Managers) to translate business needs into actionable insights, dashboards, and executive reports
Conduct advanced analytics including cost analysis of customer pay programs, workforce management planning and product/reliability validation (e.g., Vehicle Off Road calculations), to drive operational efficiency
Ensure data accuracy and compliance by validating methodologies, adhering to data governance standards, and maintaining documentation for auditability. Support predictive modeling efforts to forecast service demand, optimize resource allocation, and identify opportunities for process improvement
Review time-series data from vehicle logs. Support requests to extract and evaluate data from vehicles to aid in trend analysis, component trials, and service opportunities.Leveraging Git/GitHub for version control, code reviews, and collaborative development to ensure reliability and reproducibility



What You'll Bring


Degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent experience
Proficient with Python and SQL
Self-motivated, fast learner capable of first principle thinking in an ever-changing data landscape
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, PowerBI
Demonstrated ability to provide insights and conclusions from large, dense datasets
Detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills
Experience with time-series data, such as CAN, is preferred



Benefits
Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
Employee Assistance Program
Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
Tesla Babies program
Commuter benefits
Employee discounts and perks program



Expected Compensation

$100,000 - $216,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Title: Data Analyst - eCommerce Analytics
Description:
Tailored Brands is a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brands include Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore, which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e-commerce sites.

About The Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Data Analyst - eCommerce Analytics to join the Tailored Brands Enterprise Analytics team. As Data Analyst – eCommerce Analytics, your primary responsibility will be to extract actionable insights from data to optimize ecommerce performance with insights from site content, promotions, customer behavioral data, marketing strategies, and market data, just to name a few. You will collaborate with ecommerce product management, category management, and site operations teams to drive data-driven decisions. The primary goal is providing insights for the ecommerce and marketing teams to guide, monitor and measure their strategies.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities


Data Collection: Partner with operations to track customer actions on the website through Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics.
Data Analysis: Dive deep into customer behavior data in Google Analytics, sales data in Snowflake, and aggregated data in Power BI dashboards to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities to increase conversion, average order value, and traffic.
Reporting: Create clear, concise, and insightful dashboards via Power Bi, Looker Studio, and Excel Pivots.
Presentations: Present analyses in a clear, interpretable, and applicable way that can be shared widely, communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.
Collaborate: Partner with data engineering, ecommerce teams, and across analytics to share learnings, align on methodologies and leverage best practices.


What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, business, merchandising, or a related field is required.
Minimum of 3 years career experience in ecommerce or analytics.
Google Analytics: Proficiency in analyzing data in GA is required.
SQL: Proficiency in querying databases for data extraction is required.
Data Visualization: Experience visualizing insights effectively using Power BI, Tableau or similar tools (Power BI is Preferred)


Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands


Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time.
Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment.
Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, from a remote office location.


Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go to mytbtotalrewards.com.

Work-Life Balance

Responsibilities

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:


Meeting-Free Fridays (encouraged) | so you can catch up on work and self-development.
Summer Fridays | from Memorial Day to Labor Day so you can enjoy a head-start to the weekend.
Holiday Early Departure | close out early the business day before a company observed holiday.


The starting salary for this position is $70,200 – $110,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, and qualifications. Over time, and subject to performance, tenure, and evolving responsibilities, total compensation for this role may grow to as much as $146,300. Base pay information is based on market location and may be subject to prevailing wage laws, if applicable.

Note: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities or qualifications associated with this job.

The Market Access team, part of Cisco Strategy & Operations (CSO), enables worldwide regulatory compliance across Cisco's product portfolio. As global regulatory requirements continue to evolve, our team develops innovative, data-driven solutions that help Cisco remain compliant while accelerating business outcomes. We collaborate across the company to transform complex data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making.

Your Impact

Responsibilities

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will partner with business stakeholders to design and deliver end-to-end analytics and reporting solutions that enable data-driven decision-making. You'll transform complex business requirements into meaningful insights, develop scalable dashboards, and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through data and AI-enabled solutions. Specific Responsibilities include:


Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to gather business requirements and design scalable analytics, reporting, and dashboard solutions that support strategic business objectives.
Develop, maintain, and optimize executive dashboards, reporting tools, and data visualizations that provide actionable insights across the Market Access organization.
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, measure business performance, and deliver quantitative and qualitative insights that influence strategic decisions.
Provide ad hoc reporting, data extracts, and analytical support while identifying opportunities to automate processes and improve operational efficiency through AI and data-driven solutions.
Drive projects from concept to completion by managing priorities, communicating with stakeholders, and delivering high-quality analytical solutions.


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related technical field.
6+ years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or similar analytical role.
5+ years of experience developing dashboards and visualizations using Tableau or similar BI tools.
5+ years of experience querying and analyzing large datasets using SQL, SAP HANA, Snowflake, or similar data platforms.
Experience using Python for data analysis, automation, or data transformation.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with data analysis, data exploration, data wrangling, data transformation, and data validation techniques.
Experience with enterprise reporting platforms such as Salesforce (SFDC), SAP BI/BusinessObjects, or similar reporting tools.
Experience developing AI agents, copilots, or automation modules that integrate across enterprise applications, Microsoft Office products, and databases.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.


Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.

Job Summary

Supermicro is seeking a Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will work closely with Sales, Operations, Product Management, and Procurement teams to coordinate forecast meetings, foster cross-team alignment, and support planning initiatives.

Strong communication skills, multitasking ability, and deadline management are essential. You will generate reports, analyze trends, and interpret data using tools such as Excel, SQL, and BI dashboards, ensuring data accuracy and thorough validation.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities


Prepare and deliver monthly reports to support forecasting and business review processes.
Assist in developing and enhancing data management systems to improve forecasting capabilities.
Maintain and update forecasts on a daily and weekly basis to reflect the latest trends and insights.
Work closely with cross-functional teams—including Sales, Project Management, Product Management, and Procurement—to facilitate and support Sales Forecast meetings, ensuring alignment and effective collaboration.
Support system enhancements and changes related to operations and data workflows.
Provide strategic and analytical support to management for organizational planning and decision-making.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by applying best practices in data collection, validation, and analysis.
Monitor internal client and team feedback to identify and recommend process improvements.
Champion and uphold the company’s mission, vision, and core values in daily activities.
Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.


Qualifications


SQL Server proficiency and Data modeling — including complex queries, joins, CTEs, window functions, stored procedures, performance tuning, database design, normalization, and schema interpretation.
Microsoft 365 analytics tools: Excel, Power BI and SharePoint/OneDrive.
Data quality and validation — ability to identify anomalies, inconsistencies, and integrity issues.
Basic scripting — Python or R for data manipulation or automation.
Windows environment fluency — file systems, permissions, scheduled tasks, and general troubleshooting.
Analytical & Business Skills — Skilled in translating business questions into measurable insights through KPI development, dashboard reporting, data analysis, and adherence to data governance, security, and compliance best practices.


Required Experience


2–5 years of experience in a data analyst, business intelligence, or reporting role.
Hands‑on experience working with Microsoft SQL Server in production environments.
Experience building and maintaining Power BI dashboards or similar BI tools.
Demonstrated history of supporting business teams (finance, operations, sales, HR, etc.) with data insights.
Experience working with large datasets, data cleansing, and data validation.
Prior work in environments using Microsoft 365 for collaboration and reporting.


Preferred / Nice‑to‑Have


Experience with SSRS (SQL Server Reporting Services).
Familiarity with version control (Git) for SQL scripts or analytics code.
Experience with statistical analysis or forecasting.


Salary Range

$90,000 - $110,000

The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.

Responsible for working on big data/analytics projects that gather and integrate large volumes of data, performs analysis, interprets results and develops actionable insights and recommendations for use across the company. Strong analytic skills with the ability to extract, collect, organize, analyze and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets

Effective interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About The Role

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join our Data Team. The ideal candidate is curious, passionate, data-driven, and believes in Planet’s mission and values. You will gain first-hand experience in geospatial and enterprise data modeling and analysis. You’ll build data products and solutions such as dashboards, self-service tooling, and data pipelines for consumers across Planet, leveraging tools including git, dbt, python, SQL and Omni. What you deliver will be used to improve satellite collection performance, user experience research, business strategy, and overall customer satisfaction.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco, CA or Arlington, VA office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own


Analyze and visualize data to drive insights and inform product, business or operational problems
Work with key stakeholders across the business to define metrics to measure product and business performance
Develop and own robust, accurate data models as well as maintain, troubleshoot, and improve existing ones
Build datasets into self-service data tools leveraging modern data tooling
Contribute to a team of Data Scientists, Analysts and Engineers through discussions and code reviews


What You Bring


4+ years of relevant experience
Bachelors’ degree, technical certification, or equivalent
Expertise in SQL and python for data cleaning, aggregation and analytics
Experience with git or other version control
Familiarity with enterprise cloud platforms
Reliability and accuracy in analytics work
Experience working in a dynamic environment serving multiple stakeholder groups with different needs and technical ability
Familiarity with geospatial data use cases


What Makes You Stand Out


Experience with the modern data stack: Fivetran, dbt, Looker/Omni/Sigma, or similar
Experience enabling go to market teams with customer and financial data
Familiarity with enterprise cloud platforms (GCP preferred)

Title: Data Reporting Analyst III
Description:
PLEASE NOTE: Salary ranges are geographically based and the posted range reflects the Northen CA region. Lower salary ranges will apply for other labor markets outside of NCAL


Overview

The Market Performance team is seeking a Data Reporting Analyst III to play a strategic role in ensuring risk adjustment completeness and accuracy and driving financial performance across Medicare Advantage, ACA, and Medicaid government programs.

This pivotal role will report to the manager of the Market Performance Team and is expected to manage their workload efficiently (Jira) and collaborate with other departments and markets in Kaiser Permanente. Other duties include data mining (Synapse SQL, Databricks, Python), researching key metrics driving market performance to support understanding of reported metrics (Power BI, Excel, HealthConnect), providing Medicare Advantage (MA)/Affordable Care Act (ACA) and Medicaid risk score forecasting support, consistently applying storytelling fundamentals to analyses, and presenting research findings that directly support strategic decision-making and operational excellence (using PowerPoint).

Job Summary

This individual contributor is primarily responsible for supporting data-informed decisions, gathering data and information on targeted variables in an established systematic fashion, and preparing data for analytic efforts. This position develops, implements, and automates business and reporting solutions and supporting data analysis interpretation.

Essential Responsibilities


Pursues self-development and effective relationships with others by proactively providing resources, information, advice, and expertise with coworkers and customers; influencing others through technical explanations and examples; providing occasional mentoring to team members; listening and responding to, seeking, and addressing performance feedback; creating plans to capitalize on strengths and develop weaknesses; anticipating and responding to the needs of others; and adapting to and learning from change, difficulties, and feedback.
Completes work assignments by applying up-to-date expertise in subject area to generate creative solutions; ensuring all procedures and policies are followed; leveraging an understanding of data, and resources to support projects or initiatives; collaborating cross-functionally to solve business problems; identifying and monitoring priorities, deadlines, and expectations; communicating progress and information; identifying, recommending, and implementing ways to address improvement opportunities; and escalating issues or risks as appropriate.
Gathers data and information on targeted variables in an established systematic fashion by validating data sources; querying, merging, and extracting data across sources; completing routine data refresh and update; developing and/or delivering tools for electronic data collection; and providing user training, support, and documentation.
Prepares data for analytic efforts by consolidating data; reviewing data for quality and accuracy; profiling data inaccuracies; and cleaning and creating final data set(s) for analysis.
Develops, implements, and automates business and reporting solutions by working with stakeholders in their design, planning, and implementation while ensuring consistency and coherency; summarizing data and results; creating summary statistics; organizing data reports, visualizations, and/or interactive Business Intelligence (BI) reports; identifying needs for the development and implementation of additional reporting solutions; and preparing documentation as appropriate.
Supports data analysis interpretation by applying findings to contextual settings under the guidance of more senior employees; and developing reports and presentations telling a compelling story to stakeholders to enable and influence decision making.
Supports data-informed decisions by consulting with clients to identify and clarify key business needs; developing outcomes and process measures; translating business requirements; determining data/information needs and data collection methods; developing analysis plans; measuring the impact of business decisions on clients, customers, and/or members; working with clients and staff to identify opportunities and methods to improve efficiencies with analysis; supporting and training end-users; and documenting processes and deliverables.


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelors degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Social/Physical/Life Science, Business, or related field and Minimum three (3) years experience in data analytics or a directly related field. Additional equivalent work experience in a directly related field may be substituted for the degree requirement.


Additional Requirements


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs): Data Extraction; Data Visualization Tools; Statistical Programming Language; Relational Database Management; Project Management; Business Planning


Preferred Qualifications


Accredited Project Management Certification.
Accredited Process Improvement Certification.

Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:
Integration meets Innovation

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

As a Product Data Analyst  you will play a critical role in Celigo’s success and help execute quantitative research tasks throughout the product development lifecycle to ensure that we’re solving the right problems and providing the right solutions for our target audiences and users. The Product Data Analyst  works strategically, proactively, and collaboratively to inform and influence product roadmaps and business goals.

We are seeking a Product Data Analyst to partner closely with UX Research, Product Management, Design, Content, Engineering, and Customer-facing teams to uncover actionable insights from behavioral and product usage data.

This role sits within the UX Research team in the Product organization and will partner closely with  product managers and designers to uncover actionable insights from behavioral and product usage data.

This is not a reporting-only role. It is a strategic position focused on uncovering, identifying, and transforming complex data into clear recommendations that drive measurable improvements in user experience, adoption, retention, and business impact.

What would you do if hired?
Partner with members of the Design, Content, and Product Management teams to uncover what they need to learn from quantitative data sources (and why) and then identify, pull, and analyze the necessary data to provide them with actionable insights rather than tables of raw data.
Collaborate closely with designers to define, track, and report on metrics that demonstrate the business and user impact of their work as well as craft measurable hypotheses for new and existing features.
Be curious, proactively analyze data, and surface insights that influence product strategy, roadmap decisions, and customer experience improvements.
Help train peers to effectively utilize user research findings and usage metrics to guide and improve design decisions.
Support research operations tasks such as pulling recruitment lists and answering ad-hoc data questions.
Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting frameworks that empower cross-functional teams.
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
Identify leading indicators of engagement, activation, retention, and expansion.
Collaborate with Product Operations, Engineering, and Data teams to ensure clean, reliable event tracking and instrumentation.
Influence stakeholders across functions to gain support for research-based, user-centric solutions.


Who are we looking for?Skills & Abilities
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills, along with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to multitask and operate as a consultant across multiple product areas.
Ability to analyze and synthesize data, and guide product managers, designers, and engineers on how to act on the findings.
Aptitude for learning complex technological concepts.
Actively seeks and offers candid, constructive feedback with curiosity, humility, and openness.

Education & Experience  

4–6+ years of experience in Product Analytics or a similar role supporting B2B SaaS or enterprise software products.
Strong SQL skills and experience querying large datasets from multiple applications in a data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake).
Experience working with product analytics tools (e.g., Pendo, Google Analytics) and BI tools (e.g., Sigma).
Experience in defining and measuring KPIs such as activation, engagement, retention, churn, and feature adoption.
Work samples (case studies, portfolio, website, or similar) demonstrating the depth and breadth of your abilities, and their impact on the business.
Experience working in B2B SaaS, enterprise, or technically complex platforms.
Proven experience working with multi-disciplinary teams (Design, Engineering, Business, R&D, and others) to ideate, iterate, launch, and refine new product designs.
Experience with statistical tools (e.g., R, Python). Experience with methods such as cluster analysis, multivariate regressions, and two-proportion Z-tests is a plus.
Degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science, or related quantitative field (or equivalent experience).

Celigo reasonably expects to pay a base salary between $140,0000 and $175,000 per year for this position. Actual starting base pay will be determined by skills, experience, geographic location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, benefits, or other perks as outlined in any formal employment offer made.

Celigo is proud to be

A 2025 Gartner Customers’ Choice for iPaaS. The only vendor to receive this award.
Celigo is a Visionary in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for iPaaS for the second consecutive year
Celigo is ranked #1 iPaaS on G2 for multiple quarters and named a Leader in both B2B/EDI and API Management.
Celigo is a leading intelligent automation platform that puts the power of automation in the hands of every team, unifying workflows from the predictable to the fully agentic in a single platform.

Here you'll experience

Remote-first culture, built on trust, collaboration, and transparency
A high-growth, inclusive work environment where innovation thrives and ideas are implemented
Lightspeed learning opportunities to keep you at the leading edge of your field
Exceptional coworkers who challenge and inspire you daily
Competitive compensation and benefits, including:
Three weeks of vacation (starting year one)
Wellness days and holidays to recharge
Parental leave and a generous benefits package
Monthly tech stipend
Recognition and career development opportunities

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility

As a company, one of the values we hold most dear is fostering a safe, collaborative environment to bring out the best in us, so we created our Taking a Stand Initiative. Our TAS initiative is a volunteer committee open to all Celigans, with representation from underrepresented voices within our company. We believe, unequivocally, that everyone deserves to be in a place where they feel welcome as they are. Learn more about Taking a Stand.

We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, disability, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Title: Analyst- SF
Description:
About Us

RZR Global is an AI company that builds advertising solutions to drive mobile revenue growth. We use AI to find audiences in a privacy-first world using trillions of contextual bidding signals coupled with proprietary behavioral models. Our audience engagement platform includes a full-service agency team and a Unified Creative Strategy that delivers ad creative ideation and execution. We have worked with hundreds of advertisers over 14 years and see 5M mobile ad requests per second from over 10B devices, driving performance for publishers and brands. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with offices in the United States, EMEA, and APAC.

Role Overview

As an Analyst at RZR Global, Inc., you will play a critical role in driving data-driven decision-making processes and optimizing our advertising strategies. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to analyze large datasets, uncover actionable insights, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our advertising campaigns. Your expertise in data analysis and your ability to communicate findings effectively will be essential in shaping our success.

Responsibilities


Run campaign optimization, data trend analysis, and missing opportunity analysis to identify areas of improvement and growth for assigned accounts.
Collaborate with key members of the Product, Data Science, Engineering, and Business Development teams by providing data-driven insights and recommendations.
Drive growth of the organization through analytical and business development projects.
Own analytics-related conversations with clients and drive success for the assigned accounts.


Skills & Experience


Graduate of Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or any other analytical field.
At least 2 years of hands-on analytics experience in the programmatic media advertising/ad tech industry.
Comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment.
Experience using BI tools (Tableau, Sisense, etc.).
Foundational knowledge and experience using SQL, Python, R, and related data query tools.


Benefits


The San Francisco salary range for this full-time position is $85,000-$140,000 inclusive of base, bonus, and other benefits.
Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, People
Description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About This Role

We’re hiring a Senior Data Analyst to support our People organization, using data to help Fivetran attract, develop, engage, and retain exceptional talent as we scale. You’ll work across the employee lifecycle — from recruiting and workforce planning to employee experience, learning and development, performance, and retention — turning complex people data into insights that shape how we build and support our teams.

This is a high-impact, highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of data, people, and strategy. You’ll partner closely with leaders across People, Recruiting, Finance, and the broader business to answer important organizational questions, develop scalable analytical frameworks, and improve how decisions are made.

This is a full-time, flexible hybrid position based out of our Oakland, CA or NYC, NY office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration. There is no mandate on the number of days required but we encourage employees to come in every week to collaborate.

Technologies You’ll Use


SQL (BigQuery / Snowflake)
dbt / dbt State
Looker / LookML
Sigma / Hex / Google Sheets
Claude Code / Codex
HRIS, ATS, and other People systems and data sources



What You’ll Do


Define and own our core People metrics. Establish clear definitions and reporting across areas such as headcount, hiring, retention, organizational health, employee experience, and talent development.
Build scalable analytical products. Create canonical datasets, models, and self-service tools and dashboards that enable People teams and leaders to answer important questions quickly and consistently.
Serve as a trusted thought partner. Translate analyses into clear narratives and recommendations for audiences ranging from functional operators to senior executive leadership. Work closely with our Engineers to improve Fivetran's own HRIS and ATS connectors.
Set a high bar for responsible People Analytics. Help establish strong practices around data quality, integrity, governance, privacy, appropriate access, and the responsible use of sensitive employee data.
Turn people data into decisions. Analyze complex and disparate datasets to identify trends, surface opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to People leaders and business stakeholders.
Shape our analytics culture. Mentor other analysts and partners, establish analytical best practices, and help People teams develop stronger data fluency and decision-making habits.



Skills We’re Looking For


5+ years of experience in analytics, data science, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced proficiency in SQL and data modeling, with experience working across large, complex datasets
Experience using Looker, Tableau, Sigma, or similar business intelligence and visualization tools
Strong analytical judgment and a track record of translating ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for data quality, analytical rigor, and reproducibility
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills; you can make complex findings intuitive and help decision-makers understand not just what is happening, but why it matters and what to do next
Comfort operating in ambiguity, developing hypotheses, and owning analytical problems end-to-end
Strong cross-functional instincts and the ability to build trusted relationships with both technical and non-technical partners
A builder mindset: you look beyond answering one-off questions and create frameworks, datasets, and tools that make future decisions faster and better
Passion for using data to improve how organizations attract, develop, and support their people
Experience using analytics to support key business decisions, preferably at a high-growth, SaaS, or B2B product company



Bonus Skills


Experience in People Analytics, workforce analytics, recruiting analytics, HR strategy, or another People-related analytical function
Familiarity with HRIS, ATS, performance management, engagement, or learning systems

  • Familiarity with HRIS, ATS, performance management, engagement, or learning systems
