Title: Data Analyst
Description:
SUMMARY:

The Data Analyst will be involved in the programming, data mining and analysis of clinical, operational and financial data with an emphasis on supporting the organizational quality initiatives. The Data Analyst will support the Quality and IT teams and other organizational departments in the collection, monitoring and utilization of data to assist the organization in achieving its goals.




To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.







ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Collect, analyze, and explain data to key stakeholders and executive leadership
Run reports and gather valuable insights from various tools (Athena, Centricity, Health Catalyst, VistaSolutions preferred).
Identify trends across data and make recommendations to senior management
Works with the stakeholders for input and designs a data solution that fits within the processes of the organization
Develop data reporting and visualization capabilities
Be a data evangelist: collaborate with both technical and non-technical teammates to supplement decisions with quantitative evidence
Always be auditing: build and maintain processes to track data and troubleshoot errors
Build and automate tools to surface key data to stakeholders across a broad range of data literacy levels
Provide ad hoc analysis and forecasting as needed across a diverse set of teams
Understand the business operating procedures and the influence it has on data and performance
Performs all other related duties as assigned

 

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES    

Manages and supervises staff listed below, including hiring, training, evaluating and managing performance to meet departmental efficiency and performance measures in keeping with the Union Collective Bargaining Agreement (CAB), Personnel Policies and Procedures and prevailing employment laws as appropriate

None

 

 

Benefits: 

Full-Time Benefits:

Paid Time off (Vacation, Paid Sick Leave and Paid Leave)
Full Health Benefits (Medical , Dental , Vision, Disability, Life Insurance. )
403B Retirement Plan.




QUALIFICATIONS:

Education:

 

Bachelor’s Degree in IS, Computer Science, Statistics or similar preferred

Licensure:

 

 

Experience:

 

Expertise in data manipulation, ideally using at least one of SQL or SSRS.

Special Training:

 

 

Demonstrated Competencies:

Commitment to providing health care to families in a medically underserved community. Willingness to be flexible in the development of new methods of health service delivery. Ability to deal with sensitive information in a highly confidential manner. Effective communication skills, both oral and written, with patients, families, visitors, co-workers, health care professionals, funders and other regulatory agencies. Bilingual in English and another language appropriate to the health center’s patient population preferred, but not required. Ability to function independently with minimal supervision, and to plan, coordinate, and carry out those tasks necessary to meet the job responsibilities. Awareness of resources available within the health center to accommodate the needs of patients. Commitment to providing cost conscious, fiscally responsible, timely, efficient, effective, safe, patient-centered, culturally competent, equitable, and participatory health care. Processes personal health information in accordance with HIPAA policies and procedures.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

The Game Intelligence team within the Enterprise Intelligence organization is involved in every aspect of data at EA, using it to deliver valuable insights and solutions for game teams and players. We drive strategy, build data and AI tools, and support personalization, experimentation, and analytics. Join GI to work with experts dedicated to improving understanding, workflows, and player experiences.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Analyst, Insights to join our analytics team supporting a high-definition title in development. In this hybrid role based in Vancouver, you’ll collaborate with product managers, engineers, game designers, and quality teams to enhance player experiences and drive business outcomes through data. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Analytics, you’ll use your expertise to inform strategic decisions across product optimization, gameplay features, technology, testing, and overall quality.

What You'll Do


Analyse player and product data to uncover patterns and recommend opportunities to improve performance, stability, automation and test coverage and bug metrics
Build dashboards, reports, and visualisations that help stakeholders make better, faster decisions
Contribute to the development of predictive models and other applications of machine learning that personalise player experiences or support product decisions
Explore and apply generative AI tools to increase the efficiency of your own work and support scalable insights
Work with partners to define the right questions to ask and the right data to use, helping embed data in daily decision-making
Present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences


What You'll Bring


3+ years of experience in data analysis or applied analytics, in gaming, software, mobile apps, or similar
Proficiency in SQL for querying large datasets; experience with analysis and modelling in Python or R
Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, PowerBI
Ability to translate business needs into technical data requirements
Experience with or interest in using machine learning and generative AI tools to support analytics or player insights
You will use storytelling to convert business objectives into analytical questions, and communicate results with practical recommendations and actionable steps.
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills
Ability to independently manage assigned tasks including work planning for assigned deliverables


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$92,900 - $129,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

Title: Data Analyst (HQ)
Description:
Koniag Services Inc., a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a talented and experienced Data Analyst to support headquarters-level data analysis, performance reporting, and strategic decision support for our IT Call Center program operations in the Washington, DC area. The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and detail-oriented professional with a strong command of data analytics, reporting tools, and visualization platforms, and a demonstrated ability to synthesize complex, multi-site operational data into clear and compelling insights for senior leadership and government stakeholders. They bring a strategic perspective, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-visibility headquarters environment. Ability to obtain a government security clearance may be required to support Koniag Services Inc. and our government customers. This position is located in the Washington, DC area.

We offer competitive compensation and an extraordinary benefits package including health, dental and vision insurance, 401K with company matching, flexible spending accounts, paid holidays, three weeks paid time off, and more.

Position Description

The Headquarters Data Analyst will serve as a central analytical resource supporting the enterprise-wide performance monitoring, reporting, and data governance functions of the IT Call Center program. This individual will work closely with the Senior Program Manager, program leadership, and site-level operations teams to aggregate, analyze, and present program-wide performance data, support strategic planning activities, and ensure that all headquarters-level reporting requirements are met with accuracy and consistency. Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:


Serve as the primary data analyst supporting headquarters-level program performance monitoring, aggregating and analyzing operational data from multiple call center sites to provide a comprehensive, enterprise-wide view of program performance.
Design, develop, and maintain advanced performance dashboards, scorecards, and analytical reports that provide senior program leadership and government stakeholders with timely, accurate, and actionable visibility into program-wide call center performance metrics.
Collect, validate, and consolidate operational data submissions from site-level operations teams, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and completeness of all data inputs prior to incorporation into headquarters-level reports and briefings.
Conduct in-depth analysis of program-wide operational data including call volumes, ticket trends, SLA compliance, first call resolution rates, escalation patterns, workforce utilization, and customer satisfaction scores, identifying cross-site trends, performance gaps, and strategic improvement opportunities.
Lead the preparation and quality assurance review of all headquarters-level customer-facing deliverables including monthly and quarterly performance reports, program scorecards, and executive briefing materials for senior government leadership.
Support the Senior Program Manager and headquarters leadership team in the development of data-driven strategic recommendations, program improvement initiatives, and resource allocation strategies informed by enterprise performance data.
Develop and maintain a program-wide operational metrics baseline and performance benchmarking framework, conducting regular comparisons across sites and against industry standards to identify best practices and areas requiring targeted improvement.
Collaborate with site-level operations analysts and program staff to ensure alignment of data definitions, reporting methodologies, and performance measurement standards across all program locations.
Support data governance activities including the development and enforcement of data quality standards, reporting templates, data dictionary maintenance, and analytical process documentation.
Assist in the management and continuous improvement of the program's data infrastructure, including ITSM platform reporting configurations, data extraction processes, and dashboard maintenance.
Prepare and present analytical findings, program performance summaries, and strategic recommendations to senior program leadership and government stakeholders in both written and verbal formats.
Respond to ad hoc data requests and analytical tasks from headquarters leadership and government stakeholders, delivering accurate, insightful, and well-presented outputs within established timelines.
Support continuous improvement initiatives at the headquarters level by identifying cross-site operational inefficiencies, analyzing root causes, and developing data-supported improvement recommendations.
Contribute to business development activities as needed, including supporting proposal efforts with program performance data, analytical capability narratives, and past performance documentation.


Required

Education and Experience:


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Administration, Information Technology, Statistics, Operations Management, or a related field from an accredited college or university.
4+ years of experience in a data analysis, business intelligence, or operations analysis role, with demonstrated experience supporting enterprise-level or multi-site reporting functions.
Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining performance dashboards, analytical reports, and data visualization products for senior leadership and executive audiences.
Experience working within a federal government contracting environment.
Experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources to produce consolidated, enterprise-level analytical outputs.


Preferred


Master's degree in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related field.
Prior experience supporting headquarters or enterprise-level data analysis functions for a federal IT call center, service desk, or IT managed services program.
Experience working in a high-visibility, senior leadership-facing analytical role within a government contracting environment.


Required Skills And Competencies


Exceptional communication skills in English – both written and oral – with the ability to present complex data findings, analytical insights, and strategic recommendations clearly and persuasively to executive-level government stakeholders and senior program leadership.
Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to aggregate, validate, and interpret large volumes of multi-source operational data to identify enterprise-wide trends, performance patterns, and strategic improvement opportunities.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, dynamic charting, and macro development for sophisticated operational reporting and analysis.
Advanced proficiency in data visualization platforms such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools, with demonstrated experience designing executive-level dashboards and interactive, multi-site analytical reports.
Proficiency in data querying languages such as SQL for extracting, transforming, and analyzing data from relational databases and ITSM platforms.
Hands-on experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or equivalent systems, including experience extracting and analyzing platform data for enterprise reporting purposes.
Working knowledge of IT service management principles and ITIL frameworks, including SLA governance, incident management, and continuous service improvement.
Strong data governance skills with experience developing and enforcing data quality standards, reporting templates, and analytical process documentation.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams and SharePoint for documentation, communication, and reporting purposes.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-priority deliverables simultaneously, maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced headquarters environment.
Ability to obtain and maintain a government security clearance as required.


Desired Skills And Competencies


Active government security clearance (Secret or higher).
ITIL Foundation certification or higher (ITIL Intermediate or ITIL 4 Managing Professional).
Experience with advanced analytics or statistical programming languages such as Python or R for large-scale data analysis and modeling.
Lean Six Sigma White Belt, Yellow Belt, or Green Belt certification.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or demonstrated project management experience supporting analytical programs.
Experience with enterprise data warehouse platforms, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, or equivalent data integration tools.
Familiarity with federal IT governance frameworks and reporting requirements such as FITARA, FedRAMP, or NIST cybersecurity standards.
Experience supporting quality assurance (QA) programs and integrating customer satisfaction data into enterprise performance reporting frameworks.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About the Company

South Coast Community Services is a behavioral health nonprofit with over 40 years of history serving individuals, families, and youth across Southern California. SCCS delivers mental health services through county contracts with San Bernardino County and Orange County, managed care agreements, commercial insurance, and school district partnerships (NPA-certified). Our team of 400 includes more than 160 clinicians operating across San Bernardino and Orange Counties and beyond. SCCS accepts Medi-Cal, managed care, and commercial insurance plans.




About the Role

The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for supporting organizational decision-making through the development of reliable reporting, data analysis, and documentation of systems and data structures. This role works across clinical, operational, and financial datasets to produce accurate, actionable insights and maintain a clear understanding of how data flows across systems.




The position requires strong technical skills in SQL and Tableau, along with the ability to work with complex relational data environments, including behavioral health EHR systems. A key focus of this role is ensuring data clarity and consistency by documenting existing data sources, reporting logic, and system relationships, enabling more effective and scalable analytics across the organization. This role partners with stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Care, Finance, Clinical Operations, and IT to deliver reporting and analysis that supports day-to-day operations and ongoing performance improvement.




Responsibilities

Data Analysis and Reporting

Develop, maintain, and enhance Tableau dashboards and reports supporting referral tracking, intake performance, clinician activity, and program metrics.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, join, and transform data from complex relational databases.
Produce recurring and ad hoc reports to support operational and strategic decision-making.
Ensure accuracy and consistency of reported data through validation and reconciliation processes.




Data Systems Documentation and Structure

Document current data systems, including data sources, table structures, field definitions, and relationships across systems.
Maintain clear documentation of reporting logic, metric definitions, and calculation methodologies.
Identify gaps or inconsistencies in data structures and escalate opportunities for improvement.
Support the development and maintenance of data dictionaries and internal documentation resources.




Data Quality and Integrity

Perform regular audits to identify data inconsistencies, missing values, or reporting discrepancies.
Partner with IT and operational teams to investigate and resolve data quality issues.
Ensure alignment between source system data (e.g., EHR, CRM, billing systems) and reporting outputs.




Cross-Functional Support

Collaborate with stakeholders to understand reporting needs and translate business questions into data queries and visualizations.
Support multiple departments including Marketing, Finance, Customer Care, and Clinical Operations with data requests and analysis.
Present findings in a clear, concise manner appropriate for both technical and non-technical audiences.




EHR and Data Environment Support
Work with behavioral health EHR data to support reporting and analysis needs.
Assist in extracting and validating data from EHR and connected systems.
Develop familiarity with system workflows and data capture processes to improve reporting accuracy.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields such as data analytics, statistics, mathematics, health informatics, or related discipline.
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in a data analyst or similar role.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, aggregations, and data transformation.
Experience building dashboards and visualizations in Tableau or a similar BI tool.
Experience working with complex relational databases and multi-source data environments.
Demonstrated ability to document data systems, reporting logic, and workflows clearly and accurately.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and integrity.




Preferred Skills




Experience working in healthcare or behavioral health environments.
Familiarity with EHR systems and healthcare data structures.
Understanding of basic financial or operational metrics in a service-based organization.
Experience supporting cross-functional teams with reporting and analytics.




Pay range and compensation package

$100,000 - $125,000

This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.

You bring clarity and structure to complex problems

You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement

You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity

We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan

Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!

Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Why Bison:


Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability



Bison Transport is committed to Diversity and Inclusion in the Workplace.

Job Description

Federal Lead Data Analyst

This role is based in our Arlington, VA office

We’re on a journey to advance how health happens with technologies that support clinicians, inspire innovation, empower patients, and save lives. Our mission? To create a human-centric healthcare experience powered by unified global data.

It’s a big challenge, but big challenges are what we do best. We’re already transforming some of the world’s largest health systems—helping them turn data into lifesaving decisions and better patient care.

We want people just as dedicated as we are making history with the advancement of Federal Healthcare systems. If you’re excited about making healthcare more human, you’ve come to the right place.

Oracle Health Government Services is seeking a skilled Federal Lead Data Analyst to support mission-driven healthcare programs. In this role, you will analyze program, operational, financial, and performance data to help teams make informed decisions, identify risks and trends, and improve delivery outcomes. You will work closely with program leaders, functional teams, and technical teams, to build reports, dashboards, models, and insights that support Federal Healthcare initiatives.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a regulated federal environment. This person should be able to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities:


Analyze program data to identify trends, risks, issues, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to support program leadership and client decision-making.
Develop analytical models to support forecasting, capacity planning, budget tracking, operational performance, and program health assessments.
Gather, clean, validate, and transform data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and usability.
Partner with program managers, business stakeholders, and technical teams to define metrics, reporting needs, and success measures.
Support program risk management by analyzing leading indicators, dependencies, schedule trends, and performance data.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations, executive summaries, and presentation materials.
Support business process improvement efforts through data-driven analysis and documentation.
Ensure work products meet quality, compliance, and documentation standards.
Contribute to continuous improvement of reporting processes, data models, and analytics practices.
Operate effectively within Federal Healthcare, government contracting, and security-sensitive environments.



Top Skills And Competencies


Strong data analysis, data modeling, and problem-solving skills.
Intermediate to advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, Power Query, and data validation.
Experience with Power BI, including dashboard development, data modeling, DAX, and visualization best practices.
Experience using macros or VBA to automate reporting or improve data workflows.
Ability to interpret data and translate findings into actionable business insights.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to program leaders, clients, and cross-functional teams.
Experience working with structured data sets, operational metrics, financial data, or program performance data.
Familiarity with SDLC, business process analysis, or program management environments.
Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, regulated environment.



Preferred Education, Experience, And Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, Finance, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, or a related field.
5-7 years of experience relevant to this position including 2 years consulting experience preferred.
Experience supporting federal, healthcare, government services, or regulated programs preferred.
Experience developing dashboards, recurring reports, performance models, or operational analytics.
Familiarity with federal contracting environments preferred.
Experience with Power BI, Excel, Power Query, and VBA strongly preferred.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
Overview

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

The Joint, Office of the Secretary of Defense, Interagency Division provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues.

The Industry and Security Analysis Group (ISAG) within JOID provides analytical, technical, and program support to promote, grow, and protect the U.S. industrial base. ISAG’s support spans the Department of Defense (DOD), Department of Commerce, and other agencies to deliver critical decision support to national security leaders. Our team informs policy decisions, enables execution of comprehensive strategies and monitors and reports on the effectiveness of implementation. This enables senior leaders to execute strategies for developing and sustaining a robust industrial base that meets our nation’s strategic resource objectives. From policy to practice, we are a team of economic and national security professionals providing innovative solutions for our Nation’s most pressing security challenges.

We have an immediate need for a Sr. Data Analyst to provide onsite support out of the Pentagon and/or Mark Center in Alexandria, VA.

Responsibilities

The Sr. Data Analyst will support the newly formed Assistant Secretary of War for International Armaments Cooperation. Provide a dedicated data analytics capability in converting large volumes of data from disparate sources into decision-quality products. Manage data extraction, cleansing, and normalization from Department of War data platforms and other validated sources to support analysis and visualization for senior government leaders. Sources include Project Management Resource Tools (PMRT), Foreign Military Sales Single Tracking System (STS), International Agreements Tracking System (IATS), and Advana. Assist with streamlining ASW IAC workflows via PowerBI and PowerAutomate tools.

Qualifications

Required:


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field
3+ years of experience developing automated data pipelines, processing complex government datasets, and building business intelligence dashboards
Expert proficiency with PowerBI, PowerAutomate, and Sharepoint systems
Active Secret clearance
Able to work fully onsite based on client needs


Desired


Active TS/SCI clearance
5+ years of experience


Pay Range Information

At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, etc. Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Salaries are commensurate with experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. Virginia, Pay Transparency Salary range: USD $150,000.00/Yr. - USD $170,000.00/Yr.

Description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.

Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.

Role Overview
The Principal Data Analyst will play a key role in executing Filevine’s data and analytics initiatives. Reporting directly to executive leadership, this individual will manage daily analytics operations, deliver corporate metrics, and produce actionable insights to support operational excellence and strategic decision-making across the organization. This position requires a balance of strong technical proficiency, business acumen, and solid communication skills.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on analytical practitioner who can design and deliver high-quality analyses while engaging confidently with executive stakeholders.

Responsibilities:


Work closely with the CEO on ad-hoc or other impromptu projects, providing rapid analytical support and insights.
Lead daily operations for the corporate analytics function, overseeing the development and delivery of executive-level dashboards, KPIs, and routine reporting.
Partner with functional leaders to identify and interpret key trends across product usage, customer health, financial performance, and organizational initiatives.
Conduct complex analyses that inform strategic priorities and operational decisions.
Build and maintain robust data pipelines and models within Domo, integrating data from Salesforce, Snowflake, HubSpot, the Filevine Platform, and other enterprise systems.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and precision across all reporting outputs.
Implement frameworks for tracking key SaaS metrics and KPIs, including ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, customer engagement, and retention.
Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex data into actionable business insights.
Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, Product, and Customer Success teams to align analytics outputs with organizational goals.





Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, or a related field.
4–6+ years of experience in data analytics or business intelligence, with experience leading ad-hoc projects.
Demonstrated ability to guide projects and support team development.
Expertise in SQL and hands-on experience working with large, complex data environments.
Strong proficiency with Domo or equivalent BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
Solid understanding of Salesforce data structures and data integration practices.
Familiarity with SaaS business models and key financial metrics.
Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively present insights to senior stakeholders.
High attention to detail, with a commitment to accuracy, data governance, and analytical rigor.





Work Location Expectation: This position is based out of our San Francisco, Chicago, Salt Lake City or New York offices. Candidates residing in or near these metro areas are expected to work on a hybrid (2-3 days in-office/week) or fully onsite basis.

A dynamic, rapidly growing company, focused on helping organizations thrive

Competitive & Fair Pay

Opportunity to learn from a dedicated leadership team
Top-of-the-line company swag

The successful candidate will leverage analytics, automation solutions to improve business outcomes, operational efficiency, and customer experience.

1. Sales Optimization & Growth Support (30%)

Analyze sales performance and identify opportunities to improve lead conversion, agent productivity, and overall sales effectiveness

Support the development and measurement of customer retention initiatives.
Deliver insights that improve customer lifetime value and operational effectiveness.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure operational readiness and consistency during market expansion initiatives.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to work a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in our San Francisco or Toronto offices, and to translate complex healthcare and product data into clear, actionable insights that drive strategy and business impact. You are a fit if you thrive in ambiguous, cross-functional environments, own analytical deep work end to end, and enjoy influencing decisions through rigorous, well-communicated analysis.

What you’ll do:


Work cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success to scope and implement trusted business metrics, proactively identify data integrity issues, and optimize operational workflows.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes to inform business priorities.
Communicate analysis results and outcomes clearly and tailor messaging based on the audience.
Help build and evolve our analytical foundation, including event instrumentation, metric frameworks, and scalable self-serve analytics tools.
Mentor other analysts and raise the bar for data storytelling, analytical rigor, and stakeholder influence across the organization.


What we look for:


Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent years of practical work experience.
5+ years of experience using SQL or similar big data querying languages.
5+ years of experience with a programming language such as Python or R.
5+ years of experience with applied statistical techniques, such as inferential methods, causal methods, A/B testing, or statistical modeling techniques.
Strong experience working with Salesforce or other CRM platforms, including modeling and analyzing customer, pipeline, and revenue data.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex findings from data and models into compelling insights for technical and non-technical audiences.


Bonus (Nice to have):


Advanced degree in applied mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, economics or a related field.
Experience working with sales organizations and familiarity with funnel and pipeline processes.
Strong mentorship and leadership skills, with a track record of elevating scientific standards and developing junior talent across teams.


Benefits & Perks:

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:


Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
A home office stipend.
401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
Paid parental leave.
A local in-person meet-up program.
Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.

Title: Federal Data Analyst

Position: Federal Data Analyst

Location: Boston

About Pryzm

Pryzm is transforming how companies engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and BD is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Pryzm is backed by Tier 1 investors including a16z, and is trusted by organizations across the national security and federal technology ecosystem. Our mission is simple: deliver the best capabilities to the missions that matter most.

The Role

Pryzm's platform depends on data that most companies don't even attempt to track well. We're looking for a Federal Data Analyst to help own that data, keeping it accurate, useful, and ahead of what our customers need. The role blends technical data work with market-facing analysis, and touches everything from day-to-day data quality to the insights we put in front of customers.

What You'll Do


Own and continuously improve pieces Pryzm's federal data, noting meaningful shifts and building structural improvements within the platform
Field customer-requested data pulls end to end, from scoping the ask to delivering a clean, accurate output
Design and build new data feeds and trackers tailored to specific customer use cases and workflows
Mine Pryzm's data for patterns and signal, turning it into thought leadership for existing customers and outbound marketing
Run structured QA passes across personnel, organizational, and program data to catch errors, gaps, and staleness before customers do
Partner with the rest of the data team, shaping long-term priorities for data coverage, structure, and quality
Partner with product and engineering to translate data gaps and customer feedback into architecture and UI improvements


What We're Looking For


0-3 years of experience in a role that combined hands-on data work with analysis or research, or relevant college degree + intern experience.
Technical with Data: you can write basic SQL, work with large or messy datasets, and spot a structural problem before it becomes a customer complaint
Familiarity with government contracting or federal personnel data (USASpending awards, J-Books/budget documents, DoD organizational structure) is a strong plus, but not a requirement.
Strong analytical writing, where you can turn a dataset into a clear, credible narrative for an executive audience
High attention to detail and self-driven mindset.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly across data QA, customer requests, and longer-term projects in the same week


Qualifications


Located in Boston. This is a fully on-site position.
US Person required.
Veterans and those with military or intelligence community backgrounds strongly encouraged to apply


Benefits

Pryzm offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:


Competitive salary and meaningful equity
Platinum healthcare: comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage fully covered for employees and dependents
Basic Life/AD&D and long-term disability insurance fully covered, with the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents


Compensation Range: $75K - $90K

Data Analyst at Johnson Controls, you will be at the forefront of data-driven decision-making within the organization. Leveraging your analytical skills and expertise in data management, you will transform complex data into clear insights that drive business strategy and operational efficiency.

Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail and a strong ability to interpret complex data sets.

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Founded in 1953, Thomas Cavanagh Construction has continued to set the standard for quality construction and materials in Eastern Ontario. With our strategically located pits and quarries, our unmatched fleet of trucks and heavy equipment, our state-of-the-art facilities, and our dedicated employees, Thomas Cavanagh Construction has earned a reputation as one of Ottawa’s most trusted and respected contractors.




Overview:

The Data Analyst supports the Organizational Change Manager (OCM) and the broader digital transformation initiative by building reports, dashboards, and data views for business leaders and teams across Thomas Cavanagh Construction, using the Palantir Foundry ontology built and maintained by Cavtera. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role suited to someone strong in business intelligence, data querying, and communicating insights across all levels of the organization.

Requests that can be met using existing ontology objects — reports, dashboards, and data views — are handled directly by this role. Requests that require creating, modifying, or removing foundational ontology objects are routed to Cavtera for build. As the digital transformation function grows, this role offers the opportunity to take on broader reporting and analytics responsibilities over time.




Duties and Responsibilities:




Reporting & Dashboard Development

Build reports, dashboards, and data views within the Palantir Foundry ontology, using objects already created by Cavtera
Translate requests from business leaders and teams into clear, usable reports and dashboards
Maintain and update existing reports and dashboards as business needs evolve
Ensure reports and dashboards are accurate, well-organized, and easy for end users to interpret




Data Analysis & BI Support

Query and analyze data across the ontology and connected data sources to answer stakeholder questions
Identify data quality issues, gaps, or inconsistencies and flag them to Cavtera
Support ad hoc reporting and analysis requests from business leaders and operational teams
Apply BI and database best practices to keep reports and dashboards reliable and maintainable




Cross-Functional Collaboration

Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for developers, business leaders, and end users on approved reporting work, with new requests coming through the OCM
Gather and clarify reporting requirements from stakeholders at all levels of the organization
Work closely with the Cavtera team to understand ontology structure and available objects
Communicate reporting timelines, limitations, and options clearly to stakeholders




Scope Awareness & Escalation

Assess incoming requests to determine whether they can be met with existing ontology objects or require ontology changes
Route requests that would create, modify, or remove foundational ontology objects to the Change Management Priorities list for further assessment
Escalate reporting risks, data issues, or unresolved stakeholder needs to the OCM
Support the OCM in maintaining a clear view of reporting and dashboard requests across the organization




Requirements:

1-3 years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, data analysis, or database-related work
Strong working knowledge of SQL and comfort querying structured data to investigate business questions and produce reporting outputs
Experience working with relational data, databases, or business intelligence platforms
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to take an unclear business question and determine what information is needed to answer it
Clear, professional communication skills, with the ability to explain data and reporting concepts to non-technical audiences
Personable and collaborative, comfortable interacting with developers, business leaders, and employees at all levels
Comfort working with ambiguity and evolving processes
Experience in the construction industry is an asset
Exposure to Palantir Foundry, including tools such as Workshop, Quiver, or Contour, is an asset but not required; training will be provided on the job




Cavanagh Employee Benefits:

Family oriented work environment
Attractive, competitive compensation for qualified candidates
Internal growth opportunities
Training and development opportunities
Benefit, Wellness and Pension Plans




Wage Range:

The salary range for this position in Ontario at the start of employment is expected to be between $65K and $90K per year. However, the range offered is based on local job market factors and may vary further depending on factors specific to the selected job candidate, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Analytics & Transformation
Description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation


Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives


Business Intelligence


Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies


Data Management


Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality


Our ideal candidate will have:


Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services


Basic Qualifications:


Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms


Preferred Qualifications:


Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)

Title: Specialty Pharmacy Data Analyst
Description:
About The Job

Loopback Health is hiring an innovative and team-oriented Data Analyst within the Health System Solutions team to work on a blend of clinical, economic and operational datasets to answer questions across the healthcare delivery and life sciences value chain.

The Analyst’s role will be to inquire about the nature of the question being asked, distill the question into relevant data elements to represent, the visualization and delivery format, and presentation scheme to answer the client question at hand.

The ideal candidate will have experience interfacing with internal and external client teams, problem solving with peers, and possess a strong technical aptitude with good organizational skills and a desire to learn and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will also have excellent problem-solving skills and exhibit strong, fact-based communication skills. At Loopback you will enjoy success, develop your professional skills, and allow your career to thrive within a fast-growing business who is expanding their team.

Duties to Include


Distill complex business and technical requirements into viable analytical solutions
Partner with subject matter experts to understand root cause patterns within data
Data mapping, transformation and normalization
Data visualization and interface/ manipulation development
Analytics platform enhancements and toolset evaluations
Troubleshooting and audit trail development


Requirements

You will thrive if you:


Exhibit a “self-starter” mindset in taking ownership over delegated project responsibilities
Quickly spot non-standard patterns in data and can follow the trail back through complex data pipelines
Enjoy rapid mastery of process dimensions around problems solved with data analytics
Are a tenacious self-learner
Are detail and results oriented


You Bring a Toolkit Of Your Past Experiences Of


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst or with Data Analytics tooling (e.g. Python, SQL, PowerBI, Tableau, etc.) in a commercial capacity
Experience working with extremely large health care datasets
Demonstrated history of integrating multiple data sets to create unique insights
Implementing and designing data curation, and data analysis frameworks
Experience working across an array of stakeholders
Effective collaboration, experienced in creating technical partnerships across teams
Learning and understanding the various data domains across the enterprise and able to communicate complex relationships between clinical and business concepts across the enterprise and various stakeholders
Effectively delivering results in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities
Documenting and testing results of your analytics efforts, engaging with QA and Delivery teams to satisfy client needs


Travel


Expected to be minimal.


This employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status (e.g., H1-B) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

About Loopback

Loopback is a healthcare data company dedicated to improving access and outcomes for complex patients. We partner with health systems to grow and optimize specialty pharmacy performance, and we support life sciences organizations in accelerating evidence generation and expanding patient access through differentiated data and insights. Our work sits at the intersection of data, technology, and patient care, and we’re building a purpose-driven team that reflects that mission.

Founded in 2009, Loopback has been recognized by the Dallas Business Journal as one of the Best Places to Work, reflecting a culture grounded in collaboration, trust, and impact. Loopback has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies and consistently ranks among the fastest-growing companies in Dallas by the Dallas Business Journal.

The Analyst’s role will be to inquire about the nature of the question being asked, distill the question into relevant data elements to represent, the visualization and delivery format, and presentation scheme to answer the client question at hand.

The ideal candidate will have experience interfacing with internal and external client teams, problem solving with peers, and possess a strong technical aptitude with good organizational skills and a desire to learn and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will also have excellent problem-solving skills and exhibit strong, fact-based communication skills. At Loopback you will enjoy success, develop your professional skills, and allow your career to thrive within a fast-growing business who is expanding their team.

  • Distill complex business and technical requirements into viable analytical solutions
  • Partner with subject matter experts to understand root cause patterns within data
  • Data mapping, transformation and normalization
  • Data visualization and interface/ manipulation development
  • Analytics platform enhancements and toolset evaluations
  • Troubleshooting and audit trail development

Requirements

You will thrive if you:

  • Exhibit a “self-starter” mindset in taking ownership over delegated project responsibilities
  • Quickly spot non-standard patterns in data and can follow the trail back through complex data pipelines
  • Enjoy rapid mastery of process dimensions around problems solved with data analytics
  • Are a tenacious self-learner
  • Are detail and results oriented

You Bring a Toolkit Of Your Past Experiences Of

  • 3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst or with Data Analytics tooling (e.g. Python, SQL, PowerBI, Tableau, etc.) in a commercial capacity
  • Experience working with extremely large health care datasets
  • Demonstrated history of integrating multiple data sets to create unique insights
  • Implementing and designing data curation, and data analysis frameworks
  • Experience working across an array of stakeholders
  • Effective collaboration, experienced in creating technical partnerships across teams
  • Learning and understanding the various data domains across the enterprise and able to communicate complex relationships between clinical and business concepts across the enterprise and various stakeholders
  • Effectively delivering results in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities
  • Documenting and testing results of your analytics efforts, engaging with QA and Delivery teams to satisfy client needs

Travel

  • Expected to be minimal.

This employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status (e.g., H1-B) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Loopback is a healthcare data company dedicated to improving access and outcomes for complex patients. We partner with health systems to grow and optimize specialty pharmacy performance, and we support life sciences organizations in accelerating evidence generation and expanding patient access through differentiated data and insights. Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Why Bison:


Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability



Bison Transport is committed to Diversity and Inclusion in the Workplace.

Design and deploy analytics and visualization solutions.
Obtain and analyze raw data from multiple disparate sources to perform core job duties and to answer questions posed by internal or external customers.

Develop concise summaries of analytical exercises and clearly define recommendations and next steps

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
SUMMARY:

The Data Analyst will be involved in the programming, data mining and analysis of clinical, operational and financial data with an emphasis on supporting the organizational quality initiatives. The Data Analyst will support the Quality and IT teams and other organizational departments in the collection, monitoring and utilization of data to assist the organization in achieving its goals.




To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Collect, analyze, and explain data to key stakeholders and executive leadership
Run reports and gather valuable insights from various tools (Athena, Centricity, Health Catalyst, VistaSolutions preferred).
Identify trends across data and make recommendations to senior management
Works with the stakeholders for input and designs a data solution that fits within the processes of the organization
Develop data reporting and visualization capabilities
Be a data evangelist: collaborate with both technical and non-technical teammates to supplement decisions with quantitative evidence
Always be auditing: build and maintain processes to track data and troubleshoot errors
Build and automate tools to surface key data to stakeholders across a broad range of data literacy levels
Provide ad hoc analysis and forecasting as needed across a diverse set of teams
Understand the business operating procedures and the influence it has on data and performance
Performs all other related duties as assigned

 

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES    

Manages and supervises staff listed below, including hiring, training, evaluating and managing performance to meet departmental efficiency and performance measures in keeping with the Union Collective Bargaining Agreement (CAB), Personnel Policies and Procedures and prevailing employment laws as appropriate

None

 

 

Benefits: 

Full-Time Benefits:

Paid Time off (Vacation, Paid Sick Leave and Paid Leave)
Full Health Benefits (Medical , Dental , Vision, Disability, Life Insurance. )
403B Retirement Plan.




QUALIFICATIONS:

Education:

 

Bachelor’s Degree in IS, Computer Science, Statistics or similar preferred

Licensure:

 

 

Experience:

 

Expertise in data manipulation, ideally using at least one of SQL or SSRS.

Special Training:

 

 

Demonstrated Competencies:

Commitment to providing health care to families in a medically underserved community. Willingness to be flexible in the development of new methods of health service delivery. Ability to deal with sensitive information in a highly confidential manner. Effective communication skills, both oral and written, with patients, families, visitors, co-workers, health care professionals, funders and other regulatory agencies. Bilingual in English and another language appropriate to the health center’s patient population preferred, but not required. Ability to function independently with minimal supervision, and to plan, coordinate, and carry out those tasks necessary to meet the job responsibilities. Awareness of resources available within the health center to accommodate the needs of patients. Commitment to providing cost conscious, fiscally responsible, timely, efficient, effective, safe, patient-centered, culturally competent, equitable, and participatory health care. Processes personal health information in accordance with HIPAA policies and procedures.

Job Description

HII-Mission Technologies is seeking a Modernization Data Analyst to support the Department of War (DoW) Chief Information Officer (CIO). Come Join our growing team today!

We are seeking a skilled Modernization Data Analyst to support DoW CIO through their IT Modernization effort. This IT transformation is foundational to building a more lethal and ready Joint Force capable of operating in contested environments, which is essential for facing and deterring current and future threats. We encourage you to apply!

This position requires a SECRET level security clearance and will work onsite in Arlington, VA.

Salary for this position will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skill set, while also considering internal equity and market competitiveness.

LEVEL 2 - $73,025 - $104,321

LEVEL 3 - $94,520 - $135,028

Essential Job Responsibilities


Analyze large, complex datasets from multiple legacy and modernized systems to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for optimization.
Collaborate with software engineers, system architects, and cybersecurity teams to ensure data integrity and accessibility across modernization efforts.
Translate technical data findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support data integration activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with Department of War (DoW) data governance standards.
Contribute to the development of data quality metrics and automated validation processes.


Minimum Qualifications


LEVEL 2 - 3 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 1 year relevant experience with Masters in related field.
LEVEL 3 - 6 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 4 years relevant experience with Masters in related field.
Strong understanding of relational databases, ETL processes, and data warehousing concepts.
Familiarity with DoW data security and compliance requirements (e.g., FISMA, NIST standards) is highly desirable.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise manner.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Collaborative team player willing and eager to learn.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a structured environment.
Clearance: A SECRET level security clearance is required.


Preferred Requirements


TS/SCI is preferred.


Physical Requirements


May require working in an office, industrial, shipboard, or laboratory environment. Capable of climbing ladders and tolerating confined spaces and extreme temperature variances.

Location: Midtown NYC (Hybrid - 4 days onsite)

Compensation: $130,000 - $140,000 + performance bonus

This Data Analyst position will focus on analyzing product performance, market trends, and client distribution data. Responsibilities

What You’ll Do


Product Analytics & Telemetry: Analyze product usage, feature adoption, and telemetry data alongside financial metrics to optimize user experience and support product strategy.

What You'll Bring


Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).
Technical Stack:
Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Amplitude, Gainsight).

Multinational young team environment
Hybrid working mode ﻿
